guide.summary: Chinese links two clauses with a matched pair: an opener in the first clause (因为, 如果, 不管, 只有) and a fixed partner in the second (所以, 就, 都, 才). Learn each opener together with its partner, and remember that the partners 就, 才, 都, 也, 还 are adverbs: they come after the second subject, never in front of it.

subs.label: 因为…所以, 由于…因此, 既然…就, 为了
subs.focus: Choose the right opener or partner for reason, known fact and purpose. Classic errors: 因为 where the clause is a goal (needs 为了), 所以 after 既然 (needs 就), and thinking 因为 and 所以 cannot both appear as in English. Do not make 因为 against 由于 the only decision; both give a reason.

subs.label: 虽然…但是, 尽管…还是, 即使/就算…也
subs.focus: Pick the partner (但是/可是, 还是, 也) and tell a real fact (虽然, 尽管) from a supposed case (即使, 就算). Classic error: dropping 但是 because English bans 'although ... but'. 即使/就算…但是 is said colloquially: never judge-wrong. Make the first clause clearly real (已经, 昨天) or supposed (明天, 再) so only one opener fits.

subs.label: 如果/要是…就, 只要…就, 只有…才
subs.focus: Decide 就 against 才: 如果, 要是 and 只要 take 就, 只有 takes 才. Also 只要 (this is enough) against 只有 (nothing else works), decided by the 就 or 才 already in the sentence. Classic error: 只有…就. Never offer 如果 and 要是 as competing options; they are interchangeable.

subs.label: 无论/不管…都, 除了…都/还/也
subs.focus: After 无论/不管: supply 都 and a question form (谁, 什么, 怎么, 多, verb-not-verb, 还是). After 除了: choose 都 (except) or 还/也 (besides), made clear by the English cue. Classic errors: 不管 + plain statement, 不管很忙, 还 where 'except' needs 都. Never set 无论 against 不管, or 还 against 也.

subs.label: 不但…而且/还, 又…又, 既…又/也, 一边…一边
subs.focus: Match the pair: 不但 with 而且/还, 又 with 又, 既 with 又/也, 一边 with 一边. 又…又 joins qualities; 一边…一边 joins two simultaneous actions. Classic errors: 一边…一边 with adjectives, 不但 before a subject both clauses share. 很 inside 又…又 is colloquial: never judge-wrong. Never set 而且 against 还, or 又 against 也 after 既.

subs.label: 先…再/然后, 一…就
subs.focus: 先 marks step one and 再/然后 the next; 一 right before the first verb plus 就 means 'as soon as' or 'whenever'. Classic errors: 一 before its own subject (一他下课), 就 missing or before the subject, 先…就 for plain steps. 一下课他就… (subject after the 一 clause) is correct: give that alt. Never set 再 against 然后.

subs.label: 越…越, 越来越
subs.focus: 越来越 + adjective or feeling verb for change over time; 越 + verb + 越 + adjective when one thing grows with another. Classic errors: adding 很 or 非常 after 越来越, putting 越来越 before an action verb (越来越下雨), and using 越来越 where two linked changes need 越…越.

subs.label: 不是…而是, 不是…就是, 要么…要么
subs.focus: Decide by meaning: 不是 A 而是 B corrects (not A but B), 不是 A 就是 B says it is always one of the two, 要么 A 要么 B offers two options to choose from. Classic error: 就是 for 'not A but B', or 但是 in place of 而是. The English cue must make the meaning unmistakable.

subs.label: Partner after the second subject
subs.focus: Order items and judge items on where the partner sits. 就, 才, 都, 也, 还, 再 are adverbs and follow the subject of the second clause (我就去); 所以, 但是, 可是, 而且, 因此, 然后 are conjunctions and come before it (所以我去). Classic error: 就我去, 都我们喜欢, 也他来. The second clause must have its own stated subject.

rules.rule: 因为 pairs with 所以, formal 由于 with 因此; unlike English, using both halves is normal. 既然 (since, given that) takes 就 and leads to a suggestion or conclusion. 为了 gives a goal, not a cause.
rules.pattern: 因为 + reason + 所以 + result / 既然 + fact + Subject + 就 + Verb / 为了 + goal + Subject + Verb

examples.zh: 因为下雨，所以我们没去公园。
examples.py: yīn wèi xià yǔ suǒ yǐ wǒ men méi qù gōng yuán
examples.en: Because it rained, we didn't go to the park.

examples.zh: 由于天气不好，因此比赛改到了明天。
examples.py: yóu yú tiān qì bù hǎo yīn cǐ bǐ sài gǎi dào le míng tiān
examples.en: Owing to the bad weather, the match has been moved to tomorrow.

examples.zh: 既然你不舒服，就早点儿回家休息吧。
examples.py: jì rán nǐ bù shū fu jiù zǎo diǎn r huí jiā xiū xi ba
examples.en: Since you're not feeling well, go home early and rest.

examples.zh: 为了学好中文，她每天都听中文新闻。
examples.py: wèi le xué hǎo zhōng wén tā měi tiān dōu tīng zhōng wén xīn wén
examples.en: In order to learn Chinese well, she listens to the Chinese news every day.

rules.note: Either half of 因为…所以 can be left out in speech, and 由于 is also heard with 所以. Only the choice of partner and the reason/goal difference are safe to test.

rules.rule: For a real fact use 虽然 with 但是/可是, or 尽管 with 还是. For a supposed case (even if) use 即使 or 就算 with 也. Keep the partner in the second clause even though English drops 'but'.
rules.pattern: 虽然 + fact + 但是 + result / 尽管 + fact + Subject + 还是 + Verb / 即使 + case + Subject + 也 + Verb

examples.zh: 虽然这件衣服很贵，但是我很喜欢。
examples.py: suī rán zhè jiàn yī fu hěn guì dàn shì wǒ hěn xǐ huan
examples.en: Although this piece of clothing is expensive, I really like it.

examples.zh: 尽管外面很冷，他还是出去跑步了。
examples.py: jǐn guǎn wài miàn hěn lěng tā hái shi chū qù pǎo bù le
examples.en: Even though it was cold outside, he still went out for a run.

examples.zh: 即使明天下雨，我也要去。
examples.py: jí shǐ míng tiān xià yǔ wǒ yě yào qù
examples.en: Even if it rains tomorrow, I'm going.

examples.zh: 就算你不告诉我，我也知道。
examples.py: jiù suàn nǐ bù gào su wǒ wǒ yě zhī dào
examples.en: Even if you don't tell me, I know anyway.

rules.note: 虽然 may stand before or after the first subject (虽然他很忙 / 他虽然很忙). 虽然 itself can be dropped; 但是 or 可是 is normally kept. 尽管 can also be followed by 但是, and in speech so can 即使 / 就算; their standard partner is 也.

rules.rule: 如果 and 要是 (if) pair with 就; 的话 may close the if-clause. 就 comes after the second subject.
rules.pattern: 如果/要是 + condition + (的话) + Subject + 就 + result

examples.zh: 如果你有时间，我们就一起吃饭吧。
examples.py: rú guǒ nǐ yǒu shí jiān wǒ men jiù yī qǐ chī fàn ba
examples.en: If you have time, let's eat together.

examples.zh: 要是明天不下雨的话，我就去爬山。
examples.py: yào shi míng tiān bù xià yǔ de huà wǒ jiù qù pá shān
examples.en: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, I'll go hiking.

examples.zh: 如果太贵，我就不买了。
examples.py: rú guǒ tài guì wǒ jiù bù mǎi le
examples.en: If it's too expensive, I won't buy it.

rules.note: 就 is very common but not required: 如果你有问题,可以问我 is fine. A sentence without 就 is not an error; a sentence with 才 in its place changes the meaning to 'only then'.

rules.rule: 只要 (as long as: this one condition is enough) takes 就. 只有 (only if: no other condition works) takes 才. See 就, choose 只要; see 才, choose 只有.
rules.pattern: 只要 + condition + Subject + 就 + result / 只有 + condition + Subject + 才 + result

examples.zh: 只要你努力，就一定能学好。
examples.py: zhǐ yào nǐ nǔ lì jiù yī dìng néng xué hǎo
examples.en: As long as you work hard, you will certainly learn it well.

examples.zh: 只要不下雨，我们就去。
examples.py: zhǐ yào bù xià yǔ wǒ men jiù qù
examples.en: As long as it doesn't rain, we'll go.

examples.zh: 只有多听多说，才能学好中文。
examples.py: zhǐ yǒu duō tīng duō shuō cái néng xué hǎo zhōng wén
examples.en: Only by listening and speaking a lot can you learn Chinese well.

examples.zh: 只有你去请他，他才会来。
examples.py: zhǐ yǒu nǐ qù qǐng tā tā cái huì lái
examples.en: He will only come if you go and invite him.

rules.rule: 无论 and 不管 (no matter) take a question form after them (question word, verb-not-verb, or A 还是 B) and 都 in the second clause. Standard usage has no plain statement or 很 + adjective after them.
rules.pattern: 无论/不管 + question form + Subject + 都 + Verb

examples.zh: 不管天气怎么样，我都去跑步。
examples.py: bù guǎn tiān qì zěn me yàng wǒ dōu qù pǎo bù
examples.en: Whatever the weather is like, I go running.

examples.zh: 无论你去不去，我都要去。
examples.py: wú lùn nǐ qù bu qù wǒ dōu yào qù
examples.en: Whether you go or not, I'm going.

examples.zh: 不管是大人还是孩子，都喜欢这个电影。
examples.py: bù guǎn shì dà rén hái shi hái zi dōu xǐ huan zhè ge diàn yǐng
examples.en: Adults and children alike love this film.

rules.note: 也 is also possible after 无论/不管, mostly in negative sentences (不管我怎么说，他也不听), so do not use 也 as a wrong option. 不管 is more colloquial than 无论. A bare adjective after 不管 is sometimes heard in casual speech, so it is not a safe judge-wrong sentence.

rules.rule: 除了 A (以外) with 都 leaves A out: everyone or everything except A. 除了 A (以外) with 还 or 也 adds to A: besides A, also B.
rules.pattern: 除了 + A + (以外) + Subject + 都 + Verb / 除了 + A + (以外) + Subject + 还/也 + Verb + B

examples.zh: 除了小王，我们都去过北京。
examples.py: chú le xiǎo wáng wǒ men dōu qù guo běi jīng
examples.en: All of us except Xiao Wang have been to Beijing.

examples.zh: 除了周末，我每天都上班。
examples.py: chú le zhōu mò wǒ měi tiān dōu shàng bān
examples.en: I work every day except weekends.

examples.zh: 除了中文以外，他还会说日语。
examples.py: chú le zhōng wén yǐ wài tā hái huì shuō rì yǔ
examples.en: Besides Chinese, he can also speak Japanese.

examples.zh: 除了游泳，我也喜欢打篮球。
examples.py: chú le yóu yǒng wǒ yě xǐ huan dǎ lán qiú
examples.en: Besides swimming, I also like playing basketball.

rules.note: 以外 is optional in both meanings. In a negative sentence 'except' can also take 也 (除了他,谁也不知道), so keep 都 items positive.

rules.rule: 不但 (not only) pairs with 而且, 还 or 也. If both clauses have the same subject, the subject comes before 不但; if the subjects differ, 不但 comes before the first subject and the second clause usually has 也.
rules.pattern: Subject + 不但 + A + 而且/还 + B / 不但 + Subject one + Verb + 而且 + Subject two + 也 + Verb

examples.zh: 她不但会说中文，而且说得很流利。
examples.py: tā bù dàn huì shuō zhōng wén ér qiě shuō de hěn liú lì
examples.en: She not only speaks Chinese, she speaks it fluently.

examples.zh: 这家饭馆不但便宜，还很好吃。
examples.py: zhè jiā fàn guǎn bù dàn pián yi hái hěn hǎo chī
examples.en: This restaurant is not only cheap, the food is good too.

examples.zh: 不但学生喜欢她，而且老师也喜欢她。
examples.py: bù dàn xué sheng xǐ huan tā ér qiě lǎo shī yě xǐ huan tā
examples.en: Not only the students like her; the teachers like her too.

rules.note: 而且 is a conjunction (before a subject); 还 and 也 are adverbs (after it). 而且还 and 而且也 together are also common.

rules.rule: 又…又 joins two qualities of the same thing, normally with bare adjectives. 既…又 or 既…也 (both ... and) is the more formal version and also joins verb phrases. 一边…一边 is only for two actions going on at the same time.
rules.pattern: Subject + 又 + Adj + 又 + Adj / Subject + 既 + A + 又/也 + B / Subject + 一边 + Verb + 一边 + Verb

examples.zh: 这个苹果又大又甜。
examples.py: zhè ge píng guǒ yòu dà yòu tián
examples.en: This apple is both big and sweet.

examples.zh: 他既会唱歌，又会跳舞。
examples.py: tā jì huì chàng gē yòu huì tiào wǔ
examples.en: He can both sing and dance.

examples.zh: 她既是我的老师，也是我的朋友。
examples.py: tā jì shì wǒ de lǎo shī yě shì wǒ de péng you
examples.en: She is both my teacher and my friend.

examples.zh: 他一边吃饭，一边看手机。
examples.py: tā yī biān chī fàn yī biān kàn shǒu jī
examples.en: He looks at his phone while eating.

rules.note: 又…又 can also join verbs (又唱又跳), and 又很A又很B is heard in casual speech, so only adjectives with 一边 are a safe wrong sentence.

rules.rule: 先 + first step, 再 or 然后 + next step. 一 + first action + 就 + second action means the second follows at once, or every time. 先, 再, 一 and 就 all stand after the subject, directly before the verb.
rules.pattern: Subject + 先 + Verb + 再/然后 + Verb / Subject + 一 + Verb + (Subject) + 就 + Verb

examples.zh: 你先洗手，再吃饭。
examples.py: nǐ xiān xǐ shǒu zài chī fàn
examples.en: Wash your hands first, then eat.

examples.zh: 我们先去银行，然后去超市。
examples.py: wǒ men xiān qù yín háng rán hòu qù chāo shì
examples.en: We'll go to the bank first, and then to the supermarket.

examples.zh: 我一到家就给你打电话。
examples.py: wǒ yī dào jiā jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
examples.en: I'll call you as soon as I get home.

examples.zh: 他一喝咖啡就睡不着。
examples.py: tā yī hē kā fēi jiù shuì bu zháo
examples.en: Whenever he drinks coffee he can't sleep.

rules.note: 再 and 然后 are both right after 先, and 然后再 is common too, so never set them against each other. 然后 is a conjunction and can precede a subject; 再 cannot. A shared subject may also follow the 一 clause: 一下课他就回家了.

rules.rule: 越来越 + adjective or feeling verb: more and more over time, often with 了 at the end. 越 A 越 B: the more A, the more B. No 很, 非常 or 更 after 越 or 越来越.
rules.pattern: Subject + 越来越 + Adjective + (了) / Subject + 越 + Verb + 越 + Adjective

examples.zh: 天气越来越冷了。
examples.py: tiān qì yuè lái yuè lěng le
examples.en: The weather is getting colder and colder.

examples.zh: 我越来越喜欢这个城市了。
examples.py: wǒ yuè lái yuè xǐ huan zhè ge chéng shì le
examples.en: I like this city more and more.

examples.zh: 雨越下越大。
examples.py: yǔ yuè xià yuè dà
examples.en: The rain is getting heavier and heavier.

examples.zh: 你越着急，越容易出错。
examples.py: nǐ yuè zháo jí yuè róng yì chū cuò
examples.en: The more anxious you are, the more easily you make mistakes.

rules.note: 越来越 cannot go straight before an action verb: say 雨越下越大, not 越来越下雨.

rules.rule: 不是 A 而是 B: not A but B (a correction). 不是 A 就是 B: if it is not A, it is B (always one of the two). 要么 A 要么 B: either A or B, as options to choose between.
rules.pattern: 不是 + A + 而是 + B / 不是 + A + 就是 + B / 要么 + A + 要么 + B

examples.zh: 他不是老师，而是学生。
examples.py: tā bù shì lǎo shī ér shì xué sheng
examples.en: He is not a teacher but a student.

examples.zh: 我不是不想去，而是没有时间。
examples.py: wǒ bù shì bù xiǎng qù ér shì méi yǒu shí jiān
examples.en: It's not that I don't want to go; I just don't have time.

examples.zh: 他周末不是睡觉，就是玩游戏。
examples.py: tā zhōu mò bù shì shuì jiào jiù shì wán yóu xì
examples.en: At weekends he is either sleeping or playing games.

examples.zh: 要么你来我家，要么我去找你。
examples.py: yào me nǐ lái wǒ jiā yào me wǒ qù zhǎo nǐ
examples.en: Either you come to my place or I come to you.

rules.note: 不是…就是 describes how things are; 要么…要么 proposes alternatives. They overlap in some sentences, so set 而是 against 就是, and give 要么 items a clear 'you choose' context.

rules.rule: When the second clause has its own subject, the adverb partners 就, 才, 都, 也, 还 go after that subject. The conjunction partners 所以, 但是, 可是, 而且, 因此 go before it.
rules.pattern: Opener + clause + Subject + 就/才/都/也/还 + Verb / Opener + clause + 所以/但是 + Subject + Verb

examples.zh: 如果你不去，我就不去了。
examples.py: rú guǒ nǐ bù qù wǒ jiù bù qù le
examples.en: If you don't go, I won't go either.

examples.zh: 不管多忙，他都给妈妈打电话。
examples.py: bù guǎn duō máng tā dōu gěi mā ma dǎ diàn huà
examples.en: However busy he is, he phones his mum.

examples.zh: 虽然他很年轻，但是他的经验很丰富。
examples.py: suī rán tā hěn nián qīng dàn shì tā de jīng yàn hěn fēng fù
examples.en: Although he is young, he has a lot of experience.

examples.zh: 因为路上堵车，所以我迟到了。
examples.py: yīn wèi lù shang dǔ chē suǒ yǐ wǒ chí dào le
examples.en: Because of the traffic jam, I was late.

rules.note: If the second clause has no subject of its own, the adverb simply opens it: 只要你努力，就一定能学好. In speech 所以 is occasionally heard after the subject (我所以没去), so that is not a safe wrong sentence.

contrasts.wrong: 如果你不去，就我不去了。

right.zh: 如果你不去，我就不去了。
right.py: rú guǒ nǐ bù qù wǒ jiù bù qù le
right.en: If you don't go, I won't go either.

contrasts.why: 就 is an adverb, not a word like 'then' that opens the clause. It must follow the second subject 我.

right.py: zhǐ yǒu nǐ lái wǒ cái fàng xīn
right.en: Only if you come will I stop worrying.

contrasts.why: 只有 names the one condition that works, so its partner is 才. 就 belongs with 只要 and 如果.

right.py: bù guǎn xià bu xià yǔ wǒ dōu qù
right.en: I'm going whether it rains or not.

contrasts.why: In standard usage 不管 and 无论 are followed by a question form that leaves the answer open, here 下不下雨, not by a plain statement.

contrasts.wrong: 因为找到好工作，他学了中文。

right.zh: 为了找到好工作，他学了中文。
right.py: wèi le zhǎo dào hǎo gōng zuò tā xué le zhōng wén
right.en: He learned Chinese in order to find a good job.

contrasts.why: Finding a job is the goal, not something that already caused the action. A goal takes 为了; 因为 gives a cause.

contrasts.wrong: 除了星期天，我每天还上班。

right.zh: 除了星期天，我每天都上班。
right.py: chú le xīng qī tiān wǒ měi tiān dōu shàng bān
right.en: I work every day except Sunday.

contrasts.why: Sunday is left out, so the partner is 都. 还 would mean 'in addition to Sunday', which does not fit 每天.

right.py: tiān qì yuè lái yuè rè le
right.en: The weather is getting hotter and hotter.

contrasts.why: 越来越 already expresses degree. 很, 非常 and 更 cannot follow it.

right.en: He is both tall and handsome.

contrasts.why: 一边…一边 is for two actions done at the same time. Two qualities are joined with 又…又.

right.py: zhè ge cài yòu pián yi yòu hǎo chī
right.en: This dish is both cheap and tasty.

contrasts.why: Each quality takes its own 又; 和 cannot replace the second one. Keep the adjectives bare: 又很便宜又很好吃 is heard in speech, but the standard pattern has no 很.

right.py: tā yī xià kè jiù huí jiā le
right.en: He went home as soon as class ended.

contrasts.why: 一 is not 'as soon as' in front of its own subject. It goes after the subject, directly before the first verb. (一下课他就回家了, with the subject after the 一 clause, is also correct.)

contrasts.wrong: 即使明天下雨，也我要去。

right.zh: 即使明天下雨，我也要去。
right.py: jí shǐ míng tiān xià yǔ wǒ yě yào qù
right.en: Even if it rains tomorrow, I'm going.

contrasts.why: 即使 (even if) pairs with 也, and 也 is an adverb: it follows the subject 我. (即使…但是 is heard in speech; 也 is the standard partner.)

cheat: 就, 才, 都, 也, 还 go after the second subject; 所以, 但是, 而且 go before it.
如果, 要是, 只要, 既然, 一 take 就. 只有 takes 才.
无论 or 不管: put a question form after it and 都 in the second clause.
虽然 and 尽管 state a fact (但是, 还是); 即使 and 就算 suppose one (也).
除了 with 都 means except; 除了 with 还 or 也 means besides.
No 很 after 越来越; bare adjectives inside 又…又; 一边…一边 is for actions only.
Not A but B is 不是…而是; always A or B is 不是…就是; goal is 为了, cause is 因为.

items.q: 他工作的时候喜欢___喝茶___听新闻。
items.zh: 他工作的时候喜欢一边喝茶一边听新闻。
items.py: tā gōng zuò de shí hou xǐ huan yī biān hē chá yī biān tīng xīn wén
items.en: When he works he likes to drink tea while listening to the news.
items.why: Two actions done at the same time are joined by 一边…一边. 越…越 links two things that grow together, and 不是…就是 means 'one or the other'.

items.q: 我们___上课，___去图书馆。
items.zh: 我们先上课，然后去图书馆。
items.py: wǒ men xiān shàng kè rán hòu qù tú shū guǎn
items.en: First we have class, then we go to the library.
items.why: Two steps in order are 先…然后. 一…就 would mean 'as soon as', and 不是…就是 would mean 'one or the other'.

items.q: 他越跑___快，最后跑到了第一名。
items.zh: 他越跑越快，最后跑到了第一名。
items.py: tā yuè pǎo yuè kuài zuì hòu pǎo dào le dì yì míng
items.en: The more he ran, the faster he got, and in the end he came first.
items.why: 越…越 needs the second 越 right before the adjective: the more he ran, the faster. 很, 更 and 最 cannot echo the first 越.

items.q: ___老师生病了，___今天的课改到下周了。
items.zh: 因为老师生病了，所以今天的课改到下周了。
items.py: yīn wèi lǎo shī shēng bìng le suǒ yǐ jīn tiān de kè gǎi dào xià zhōu le
items.en: Because the teacher is ill, today's class has been moved to next week.
items.why: Cause and result are paired as 因为…所以. 虽然…但是 would call the illness and the change contradictory, and 如果…就 would make the illness only a possibility although it has happened.

items.src_py: tā huí dào jiā rán hòu zuò fàn
items.task: Rewrite with 一…就 (as soon as).
items.zh: 他一回到家就做饭。
items.py: tā yī huí dào jiā jiù zuò fàn
items.en: He cooks as soon as he gets home.
items.why: 一 goes right before the first verb 回 and 就 before the second action, both after the subject 他. 然后 is dropped.

items.q: 他虽然已经工作了十年，___还是每天学习新东西。
items.zh: 他虽然已经工作了十年，但是还是每天学习新东西。
items.py: tā suī rán yǐ jīng gōng zuò le shí nián dàn shì hái shi měi tiān xué xí xīn dōng xi
items.en: Although he has already worked for ten years, he still learns new things every day.
items.why: 虽然 is answered by 但是 (or 可是) before the main clause, and 还是 adds 'still'. 所以 gives a cause that does not exist, and 就 or 才 would need an if or only-if clause.

items.q: 因为今天有考试，___我昨晚学到很晚。
items.zh: 因为今天有考试，所以我昨晚学到很晚。
items.py: yīn wèi jīn tiān yǒu kǎo shì suǒ yǐ wǒ zuó wǎn xué dào hěn wǎn
items.en: Because there's an exam today, I studied until very late last night.
items.why: 所以 introduces the result of 因为 and stands before the second subject 我. 但是 would contrast, 而且 would add, and 如果 would make the exam hypothetical when it is real.

items.zh: 不但学生们来了，而且家长们也来了。
items.py: bù dàn xué sheng men lái le ér qiě jiā zhǎng men yě lái le
items.en: Not only did the students come, the parents came too.
items.why: With two different subjects, 不但 comes before the first subject. 而且 is a conjunction before the second subject, and 也 follows 家长们.

items.q: 我们先把新员工的培训安排好，___再讨论工资的问题。
items.zh: 我们先把新员工的培训安排好，然后再讨论工资的问题。
items.py: wǒ men xiān bǎ xīn yuán gōng de péi xùn ān pái hǎo rán hòu zài tǎo lùn gōng zī de wèn tí
items.en: First we'll arrange the new staff's training, and then discuss the salary question.
items.why: 先…然后(再) lines up two steps, and 然后 can open the second step before 再. 所以, 但是 and 因为 give consequence, contrast and cause instead of order.

items.q: ___明天再下大雨，我们也要去参观工厂。
items.zh: 即使明天再下大雨，我们也要去参观工厂。
items.py: jí shǐ míng tiān zài xià dà yǔ wǒ men yě yào qù cān guān gōng chǎng
items.en: Even if it pours again tomorrow, we're still going to visit the factory.
items.why: 明天 and 再 make this a supposed case: 即使 ('even if') with 也. 虽然 needs a real fact, 因为 gives a cause, and 既然 needs something already known.

items.s: 尽管任务很难，他们还是按时完成了。
items.s_py: jǐn guǎn rèn wù hěn nán tā men hái shi àn shí wán chéng le
items.zh: 尽管任务很难，他们还是按时完成了。
items.py: jǐn guǎn rèn wù hěn nán tā men hái shi àn shí wán chéng le
items.en: Even though the task was hard, they still finished on time.
items.why: 尽管 states a real fact and pairs with 还是 after the subject 他们; no 但是 is needed. The sentence is correct.

items.q: 我一看到这个题，___知道怎么做。
items.zh: 我一看到这个题，就知道怎么做。
items.py: wǒ yī kàn dào zhè ge tí jiù zhī dao zěn me zuò
items.en: As soon as I saw this question, I knew how to do it.
items.why: 一 + verb + 就 means 'as soon as ... then': 就 follows the second subject. 再 would mean 'then, later', and 也 or 还 do not mark immediacy.

items.q: 尽管作业很多，他___去打篮球了。
items.zh: 尽管作业很多，他还是去打篮球了。
items.py: jǐn guǎn zuò yè hěn duō tā hái shi qù dǎ lán qiú le
items.en: Even though he had a lot of homework, he still went to play basketball.
items.why: 尽管 states a real fact and is answered by 还是 after the subject 他: 'still'. 才 means 'only then', 又 means 'again', and 但是 cannot stand after the subject.

items.q: 这次出差不是去上海，___去北京。
items.zh: 这次出差不是去上海，而是去北京。
items.py: zhè cì chū chāi bú shì qù shàng hǎi ér shì qù běi jīng
items.en: This business trip is not to Shanghai but to Beijing.
items.why: Correcting a wrong assumption ('not A but B') is 不是…而是. 就是 would mean 'if not A then B', and 但是 or 还是 cannot follow 不是 this way.

items.src: 如果你多练习，就能说得更好。
items.src_py: rú guǒ nǐ duō liàn xí jiù néng shuō de gèng hǎo
items.zh: 只有多练习，你才能说得更好。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu duō liàn xí nǐ cái néng shuō de gèng hǎo
items.en: Only if you practise a lot can you speak better.
items.why: 只有 replaces 如果 and its partner changes from 就 to 才, after 你. Keeping 就 would be wrong.

items.q: 如果明天不上课，我___去图书馆。
items.zh: 如果明天不上课，我就去图书馆。
items.py: rú guǒ míng tiān bù shàng kè wǒ jiù qù tú shū guǎn
items.en: If there's no class tomorrow, I'll go to the library.
items.why: 如果 takes 就 after the second subject 我. 才 would turn it into 'only then', which belongs to 只有; 都 and 还 do not complete the 如果 clause.

items.q: 虽然工作很多，___我很开心。
items.zh: 虽然工作很多，但是我很开心。
items.py: suī rán gōng zuò hěn duō dàn shì wǒ hěn kāi xīn
items.en: Although there is a lot of work, I'm happy.
items.why: 但是 is a conjunction and opens the second clause before the subject 我. The adverbs 也, 都 and 才 must follow 我 and can never stand in front of it.

items.zh: 这份工作又轻松又有意思。
items.py: zhè fèn gōng zuò yòu qīng sōng yòu yǒu yì si
items.en: This job is both easy and interesting.
items.why: 又…又 puts one 又 before each quality, with no 很. Both 又 follow the topic 这份工作 and stand right before the adjectives.

items.q: ___昨天已经复习了三遍，他考得还是不好。
items.zh: 虽然昨天已经复习了三遍，他考得还是不好。
items.py: suī rán zuó tiān yǐ jīng fù xí le sān biàn tā kǎo de hái shi bù hǎo
items.en: Although he had already revised three times yesterday, he still did badly in the exam.
items.why: 已经 shows this is a real, finished fact, so 虽然 (although) fits. 即使 and 如果 suppose a case that has not happened, and 因为 would make revising the cause of doing badly.

items.q: 只要你准备好了，___就可以开始。
items.zh: 只要你准备好了，我们就可以开始。
items.py: zhǐ yào nǐ zhǔn bèi hǎo le wǒ men jiù kě yǐ kāi shǐ
items.en: As long as you're ready, we can begin.
items.why: 就 is an adverb and must follow a subject, so the second clause needs its own subject 我们 before it. 所以, 但是 and 而且 are conjunctions that cannot stand in front of 就 here.

items.zh: 即使明天没有会议，他也会来公司。
items.py: jí shǐ míng tiān méi yǒu huì yì tā yě huì lái gōng sī
items.en: Even if there's no meeting tomorrow, he will come to the office.
items.why: 即使 supposes a case, and its partner 也 follows the second subject 他. 但是 does not fit a supposed case, and 也 cannot stand before 他.

items.zh: 如果你不去开会，我就不去了。
items.py: rú guǒ nǐ bù qù kāi huì wǒ jiù bù qù le
items.en: If you're not going to the meeting, I won't go either.
items.why: The adverb 就 must follow the second subject 我, so the order is 我 + 就 + verb. Putting 就 before 我 treats it like a conjunction, which it is not.

items.zh: 她一边听老师讲课，一边做笔记。
items.py: tā yī biān tīng lǎo shī jiǎng kè yī biān zuò bǐ jì
items.en: She takes notes while listening to the teacher's lecture.
items.why: 一边…一边 joins two actions done at the same time, each 一边 right before its verb and after the subject 她.

items.zh: 不管工作多忙，他都会去运动。
items.py: bù guǎn gōng zuò duō máng tā dōu huì qù yùn dòng
items.en: No matter how busy work is, he always goes to exercise.
items.why: 不管 comes first with a question form (多忙), then the subject; 都 follows 他 and stands before 会. 都 cannot come before 他.

items.zh: 他越学越有兴趣。
items.py: tā yuè xué yuè yǒu xìng qù
items.en: The more he studies, the more interested he becomes.
items.why: 越…越 links two changes that grow together: studying more and interest rising. 越来越 would only say that something grows over time.

items.zh: 虽然这个任务很难，但是我们完成了。
items.py: suī rán zhè ge rèn wù hěn nán dàn shì wǒ men wán chéng le
items.en: Although this task was hard, we completed it.
items.why: 虽然 opens the first clause, and the conjunction 但是 opens the second one before its subject 我们. English drops 'but', Chinese keeps it.

items.s: 只有提前报名，你就可以参加比赛。
items.s_py: zhǐ yǒu tí qián bào míng nǐ jiù kě yǐ cān jiā bǐ sài
items.zh: 只有提前报名，你才可以参加比赛。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu tí qián bào míng nǐ cái kě yǐ cān jiā bǐ sài
items.en: You can take part in the competition only if you sign up in advance.
items.why: 只有 names the one condition that works, so its partner is 才. 就 belongs with 只要 and 如果.

items.q: ___你通过面试，___能进这家公司。
items.zh: 只有你通过面试，才能进这家公司。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu nǐ tōng guò miàn shì cái néng jìn zhè jiā gōng sī
items.en: Only if you pass the interview can you join this company.
items.why: 'Only if' is 只有 and its partner is 才. 只要 or 如果 take 就, and a mixed pair such as 只要…才 does not exist.

items.zh: 老师一进教室，同学们就安静了。
items.py: lǎo shī yī jìn jiào shì tóng xué men jiù ān jìng le
items.en: As soon as the teacher came into the classroom, the students went quiet.
items.why: 一 stands right before the first verb 进 and 就 right after the second subject 同学们. Neither can move to the front of its clause.

items.s: 雨越下越大，我们回家吧。
items.s_py: yǔ yuè xià yuè dà wǒ men huí jiā ba
items.zh: 雨越下越大，我们回家吧。
items.py: yǔ yuè xià yuè dà wǒ men huí jiā ba
items.en: The rain is getting heavier and heavier, so let's go home.
items.why: Before an action verb like 下 the pattern is 越 + verb + 越 + adjective, not 越来越. The sentence is correct.

items.s: 不管天气怎么样，都我们去学校。
items.s_py: bù guǎn tiān qì zěn me yàng dōu wǒ men qù xué xiào
items.zh: 不管天气怎么样，我们都去学校。
items.py: bù guǎn tiān qì zěn me yàng wǒ men dōu qù xué xiào
items.en: Whatever the weather is like, we go to school.
items.why: 都 is an adverb and must follow the second subject 我们. It cannot stand in front of it.

items.s: 一我到学校，就给你打电话。
items.s_py: yī wǒ dào xué xiào jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
items.zh: 我一到学校，就给你打电话。
items.py: wǒ yī dào xué xiào jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
items.en: I'll call you as soon as I get to school.
items.why: 一 must stand after the subject, right before the verb 到. It cannot head the clause before 我.

items.q: ___他的普通话不太标准，___大家都听得懂。
items.zh: 虽然他的普通话不太标准，但是大家都听得懂。
items.py: suī rán tā de pǔ tōng huà bù tài biāo zhǔn dàn shì dà jiā dōu tīng de dǒng
items.en: Although his Mandarin isn't very standard, everyone can understand him.
items.why: The first clause states a real fact and the second contrasts with it: 虽然…但是. 因为…所以 and 只要…就 give cause and condition, which would not make sense of 'not standard, yet understood'.

items.q: 只要明天不下雨，运动会___照常举行。
items.zh: 只要明天不下雨，运动会就照常举行。
items.py: zhǐ yào míng tiān bù xià yǔ yùn dòng huì jiù zhào cháng jǔ xíng
items.en: As long as it doesn't rain tomorrow, the sports day will go ahead as usual.
items.why: 只要 gives a sufficient condition, so the partner is 就. 才 would require 只有, and 却 or 因此 give contrast or consequence instead of a condition.

items.zh: 要么你明天来，要么我后天去找你。
items.py: yào me nǐ míng tiān lái yào me wǒ hòu tiān qù zhǎo nǐ
items.en: Either you come tomorrow, or I'll come and find you the day after.
items.why: 要么…要么 offers two options, and each 要么 stands at the head of its clause, before the subject. 不是…就是 would not offer a choice.

items.q: 不管天气怎么样，学生们___要去上学。
items.zh: 不管天气怎么样，学生们都要去上学。
items.py: bù guǎn tiān qì zěn me yàng xué sheng men dōu yào qù shàng xué
items.en: Whatever the weather is like, the students have to go to school.
items.why: 不管 + a question form (怎么样) is answered by 都, which says every case is the same. 就 and 才 belong to if and only-if sentences, and 又 means 'again'.

items.q: 只有多练习，你___能考好。
items.zh: 只有多练习，你才能考好。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu duō liàn xí nǐ cái néng kǎo hǎo
items.en: Only by practising a lot can you do well in the exam.
items.why: 只有 ('only if') names the one condition that works, so its partner is 才. 就 goes with 只要 or 如果, and 也 or 都 are not partners of 只有.

items.q: 他的中文说得越来越___。
items.zh: 他的中文说得越来越流利。
items.py: tā de zhōng wén shuō de yuè lái yuè liú lì
items.en: His Chinese is getting more and more fluent.
items.why: 越来越 expresses change over time and takes a bare adjective. A degree word such as 很, 非常 or 更 clashes with 越来越.

items.q: 同学们先读课文，___做练习。
items.zh: 同学们先读课文，再做练习。
items.py: tóng xué men xiān dú kè wén zài zuò liàn xí
items.en: The students read the text first and then do the exercises.
items.why: 先 marks step one and 再 the next step, as a plan. 又 would mean 'again', 却 would contrast, and 都 does not mark order.

items.s: 这家咖啡馆一边便宜一边好喝。
items.s_py: zhè jiā kā fēi guǎn yī biān pián yi yī biān hǎo hē
items.zh: 这家咖啡馆又便宜又好喝。
items.py: zhè jiā kā fēi guǎn yòu pián yi yòu hǎo hē
items.en: This cafe is both cheap and tasty.
items.why: 一边…一边 is only for two actions done at the same time. Two qualities of one thing are joined with 又…又.

items.q: 不管___忙，他每天都练习写汉字。
items.zh: 不管多忙，他每天都练习写汉字。
items.py: bù guǎn duō máng tā měi tiān dōu liàn xí xiě hàn zì
items.en: However busy he is, he practises writing characters every day.
items.why: 不管 needs an open question form, and 多 + adjective ('how busy') supplies it. 很, 太 and 真 state a fact, which 不管 cannot take.

items.zh: 我们先开会，再讨论预算。
items.py: wǒ men xiān kāi huì zài tǎo lùn yù suàn
items.en: We'll hold the meeting first and then discuss the budget.
items.why: 先 marks the first step and 再 the next; both are adverbs placed right before their verbs. 再 cannot open the second step in front of its verb phrase.

items.s: 不但经理同意了，而且老板也同意了。
items.s_py: bù dàn jīng lǐ tóng yì le ér qiě lǎo bǎn yě tóng yì le
items.zh: 不但经理同意了，而且老板也同意了。
items.py: bù dàn jīng lǐ tóng yì le ér qiě lǎo bǎn yě tóng yì le
items.en: Not only did the manager agree, the boss agreed too.
items.why: The clauses have different subjects, so 不但 stands before the first; 而且 opens the second clause and 也 follows 老板. The sentence is correct.

items.q: 这位同事___很认真，___很友好。
items.zh: 这位同事不但很认真，而且很友好。
items.py: zhè wèi tóng shì bù dàn hěn rèn zhēn ér qiě hěn yǒu hǎo
items.en: This colleague is not only conscientious but also friendly.
items.why: Two good qualities are added together with 不但…而且. 虽然…但是 would make them clash, and 因为…所以 would make one quality cause the other.

items.q: 除了周五，我每天___要开会。
items.zh: 除了周五，我每天都要开会。
items.py: chú le zhōu wǔ wǒ měi tiān dōu yào kāi huì
items.en: I have a meeting every day except Friday.
items.why: Friday is the exception, so the partner is 都 after 每天. 还 would add Friday as one more day, which contradicts 'except'.

items.s: 我不是在写报告，但是在开会。
items.s_py: wǒ bú shì zài xiě bào gào dàn shì zài kāi huì
items.zh: 我不是在写报告，而是在开会。
items.py: wǒ bú shì zài xiě bào gào ér shì zài kāi huì
items.en: I'm not writing a report; I'm in a meeting.
items.why: Correcting what someone assumes is 不是…而是. 但是 cannot answer 不是 in this way.

items.q: 小李___到公司就开电脑。
items.zh: 小李一到公司就开电脑。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ yī dào gōng sī jiù kāi diàn nǎo
items.en: Xiao Li switches on the computer as soon as he gets to the office.
items.why: 一 + verb + 就 means 'as soon as': 一 goes right before the first verb. 先 would need 再 or 然后 as its partner, and 再 or 还 cannot take its place.

items.q: 除了工作以外，他___喜欢爬山。
items.zh: 除了工作以外，他还喜欢爬山。
items.py: chú le gōng zuò yǐ wài tā hái xǐ huan pá shān
items.en: Besides work, he also likes hiking.
items.why: Adding a second interest is 除了…以外 + 还: 'besides work, also hiking'. 都 would mean 'everything except work', which does not fit one added hobby.

items.q: 办公室里越来越___了。
items.zh: 办公室里越来越热了。
items.py: bàn gōng shì lǐ yuè lái yuè rè le
items.en: The office is getting hotter and hotter.
items.why: 越来越 already means 'more and more', so the adjective stands bare. 很, 非常 and 太 cannot follow it.

items.s: 就算你不同意，我也要做。
items.s_py: jiù suàn nǐ bù tóng yì wǒ yě yào zuò
items.zh: 就算你不同意，我也要做。
items.py: jiù suàn nǐ bù tóng yì wǒ yě yào zuò
items.en: Even if you don't agree, I'm going to do it.
items.why: 就算 supposes a case and is answered by 也 after the subject 我. Unlike English 'but', no 但是 is needed. The sentence is correct.

items.q: 只要你认真听课，___能听懂。
items.zh: 只要你认真听课，就能听懂。
items.py: zhǐ yào nǐ rèn zhēn tīng kè jiù néng tīng dǒng
items.en: As long as you listen carefully in class, you'll understand.
items.why: 只要 ('as long as') takes 就: listening carefully is enough. 才 belongs to 只有, and 但是 or 所以 would give a contrast or a cause.

items.q: 小王不但会说英语，___会说日语。
items.zh: 小王不但会说英语，而且会说日语。
items.py: xiǎo wáng bù dàn huì shuō yīng yǔ ér qiě huì shuō rì yǔ
items.en: Xiao Wang can not only speak English but can also speak Japanese.
items.why: 不但 is answered by 而且 ('but also'). 但是 would contrast, 所以 would give a result, and 虽然 would need its own 但是.

items.zh: 只有认真复习，小王才能考好。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu rèn zhēn fù xí xiǎo wáng cái néng kǎo hǎo
items.en: Only by revising carefully can Xiao Wang do well in the exam.
items.why: 只有 names the one way, and its partner 才 sits after the subject 小王, directly before 能. 就 does not go with 只有.

items.q: ___提高口语，她每天都和同学练习说中文。
items.zh: 为了提高口语，她每天都和同学练习说中文。
items.py: wèi le tí gāo kǒu yǔ tā měi tiān dōu hé tóng xué liàn xí shuō zhōng wén
items.en: To improve her spoken Chinese, she practises speaking with classmates every day.
items.why: Improving her speaking is the goal of the daily practice, not a reason that already exists, so 为了 is needed. 因为 would turn the goal into a cause, and 所以 or 虽然 cannot open the sentence.

items.q: 虽然这道题很难，___我还是做对了。
items.zh: 虽然这道题很难，但是我还是做对了。
items.py: suī rán zhè dào tí hěn nán dàn shì wǒ hái shi zuò duì le
items.en: Although this question was hard, I still got it right.
items.why: 虽然 states a fact and its partner 但是 opens the second clause, even though English drops 'but'. 所以 and 而且 give the wrong relation, and 如果 would make the difficulty hypothetical.

items.q: 无论老板同意___不同意，我们都要按时交报告。
items.zh: 无论老板同意还是不同意，我们都要按时交报告。
items.py: wú lùn lǎo bǎn tóng yì hái shi bù tóng yì wǒ men dōu yào àn shí jiāo bào gào
items.en: Whether the boss agrees or not, we must hand in the report on time.
items.why: 无论 needs both possibilities joined as a choice: 同意还是不同意. 和 joins things and does not offer alternatives, and 而是 or 所以 give other relations.

items.zh: 因为经理出差了，所以会议取消了。
items.py: yīn wèi jīng lǐ chū chāi le suǒ yǐ huì yì qǔ xiāo le
items.en: Because the manager went away on business, the meeting was cancelled.
items.why: 所以 is a conjunction: it stands before the result clause and its subject 会议. 因为 opens the reason clause, so neither can move after the subject.

items.zh: 我不是不想去，而是没有时间。
items.py: wǒ bú shì bù xiǎng qù ér shì méi yǒu shí jiān
items.en: It's not that I don't want to go; I just don't have time.
items.why: 不是 A 而是 B corrects a wrong guess: 而是 begins the real reason. 但是 or 就是 would change the relation between the two parts.

items.q: 不管___来开会，我们都欢迎。
items.zh: 不管谁来开会，我们都欢迎。
items.py: bù guǎn shuí lái kāi huì wǒ men dōu huān yíng
items.en: We welcome whoever comes to the meeting.
items.why: 不管 needs a question word, so 谁 makes it 'whoever'. 他, 大家 and 我们 name a definite group, so nothing is left open for 都 to cover.

items.q: 她既是我的老师，___是我的朋友。
items.zh: 她既是我的老师，也是我的朋友。
items.py: tā jì shì wǒ de lǎo shī yě shì wǒ de péng you
items.en: She is both my teacher and my friend.
items.why: 既 is answered by 也 or 又: 'both ... and'. 才 and 就 are condition partners, and 都 would need a plural subject.

items.q: 他每次出差，不是坐飞机，___坐高铁，从来不自己开车。
items.zh: 他每次出差，不是坐飞机，就是坐高铁，从来不自己开车。
items.py: tā měi cì chū chāi bú shì zuò fēi jī jiù shì zuò gāo tiě cóng lái bù zì jǐ kāi chē
items.en: Whenever he travels on business he either flies or takes the high-speed train; he never drives himself.
items.why: Two habitual possibilities with nothing else allowed: 不是…就是. 而是 would deny the first and assert the second, and 还是 offers a choice only in questions.

items.q: 雨___下越大，我们只好回教室了。
items.zh: 雨越下越大，我们只好回教室了。
items.py: yǔ yuè xià yuè dà wǒ men zhǐ hǎo huí jiào shì le
items.en: The longer it rained, the harder it came down, so we had to go back to the classroom.
items.why: 越 + verb + 越 + adjective links the rain falling and its force. 越来越 cannot sit directly before an action verb like 下.

items.q: 除了英语，她___会说法语。
items.zh: 除了英语，她还会说法语。
items.py: chú le yīng yǔ tā hái huì shuō fǎ yǔ
items.en: Besides English, she can also speak French.
items.why: Adding another item is 除了 + 还: 'besides English, also French'. 都 would mean 'everything except English', which does not fit one extra language.

items.q: 因为路上堵车，___我迟到了。
items.zh: 因为路上堵车，所以我迟到了。
items.py: yīn wèi lù shàng dǔ chē suǒ yǐ wǒ chí dào le
items.en: Because of the traffic jam, I was late.
items.why: 所以 is a conjunction that goes before the second subject 我. 也, 都 and 还 are adverbs, which can only come after 我.

items.zh: 如果明天不下雨，我们就去参观工厂。
items.py: rú guǒ míng tiān bù xià yǔ wǒ men jiù qù cān guān gōng chǎng
items.en: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we'll go and visit the factory.
items.why: 如果 + condition, then 就 directly after the second subject 我们. 就 cannot stand before 我们.

items.src: 虽然他很累，但是他还在工作。
items.src_py: suī rán tā hěn lèi dàn shì tā hái zài gōng zuò
items.task: Rewrite with 尽管 and 还是.
items.zh: 尽管他很累，他还是在工作。
items.py: jǐn guǎn tā hěn lèi tā hái shi zài gōng zuò
items.en: Even though he was tired, he was still working.
items.why: 尽管 replaces 虽然 and 还是 replaces 但是. 还是 is an adverb, so it follows the second 他.

items.q: 他又高又___帅。
items.zh: 他又高又帅。
items.py: tā yòu gāo yòu shuài
items.en: He is both tall and handsome.
items.why: 又…又 takes bare adjectives, so 很 may not stand inside it: leave the blank empty.

items.q: 由于经理临时出差了，___今天的会议取消了。
items.zh: 由于经理临时出差了，因此今天的会议取消了。
items.py: yóu yú jīng lǐ lín shí chū chāi le yīn cǐ jīn tiān de huì yì qǔ xiāo le
items.en: Because the manager suddenly went away on business, today's meeting was cancelled.
items.why: 由于 gives the reason and 因此 starts the result. 因为 cannot head a result clause, and 如果 or 可是 would express condition or contrast instead of consequence.

items.q: 他一下班___回家休息。
items.zh: 他一下班就回家休息。
items.py: tā yī xià bān jiù huí jiā xiū xi
items.en: He goes home to rest as soon as he gets off work.
items.why: 一…就 means 'as soon as': the second action follows at once. 才 would say it happens late, which clashes with 一.

items.q: ___公司最近订单很多，___大家周末也要加班。
items.zh: 由于公司最近订单很多，因此大家周末也要加班。
items.py: yóu yú gōng sī zuì jìn dìng dān hěn duō yīn cǐ dà jiā zhōu mò yě yào jiā bān
items.en: Because the company has had many orders lately, everyone has to work overtime at weekends too.
items.why: 由于 gives the reason and 因此 the consequence. 可是 and 但是 would mark a contrast that the meaning does not have, and 既然…就 would need a suggestion, not a plain consequence.

items.q: 只有提前预约，客人___能进会议室。
items.zh: 只有提前预约，客人才能进会议室。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu tí qián yù yuē kè ren cái néng jìn huì yì shì
items.en: Guests can enter the meeting room only if they book in advance.
items.why: 只有 sets the single condition and takes 才 after the subject 客人. 就 would suit 只要 and 如果 but not 只有.

items.s: 我的汉语越来越非常好了。
items.s_py: wǒ de hàn yǔ yuè lái yuè fēi cháng hǎo le
items.zh: 我的汉语越来越好了。
items.py: wǒ de hàn yǔ yuè lái yuè hǎo le
items.en: My Chinese is getting better and better.
items.why: 越来越 already carries the degree, so 非常 cannot follow it. The bare adjective 好 is enough.

items.s: 既然天气不好，我们就在教室里吃午饭吧。
items.s_py: jì rán tiān qì bù hǎo wǒ men jiù zài jiào shì lǐ chī wǔ fàn ba
items.zh: 既然天气不好，我们就在教室里吃午饭吧。
items.py: jì rán tiān qì bù hǎo wǒ men jiù zài jiào shì lǐ chī wǔ fàn ba
items.en: Since the weather is bad, let's eat lunch in the classroom.
items.why: 既然 takes 就 after the second subject 我们, with no 所以. The sentence is correct.

items.q: 周末他不是看书，___睡觉，从来不出门。
items.zh: 周末他不是看书，就是睡觉，从来不出门。
items.py: zhōu mò tā bú shì kàn shū jiù shì shuì jiào cóng lái bù chū mén
items.en: At weekends he's always either reading or sleeping, and he never goes out.
items.why: 'Always one of these two' is 不是…就是. 而是 would be a correction ('not reading but sleeping'), and 要么 cannot follow 不是.

items.zh: 除了星期六，我们每天都上班。
items.py: chú le xīng qī liù wǒ men měi tiān dōu shàng bān
items.en: We work every day except Saturday.
items.why: 除了 + 都 means 'all except': 都 stands after 每天, right before the verb. 还 would add Saturday instead of excluding it.

items.s: 不管他很忙，他都会来开会。
items.s_py: bù guǎn tā hěn máng tā dōu huì lái kāi huì
items.zh: 不管他多忙，他都会来开会。
items.py: bù guǎn tā duō máng tā dōu huì lái kāi huì
items.en: However busy he is, he always comes to the meeting.
items.why: 不管 must be followed by an open question form such as 多忙 ('how busy'). 很忙 is a plain statement, which 不管 cannot take.

items.s: 除了小李，大家都来了。
items.s_py: chú le xiǎo lǐ dà jiā dōu lái le
items.zh: 除了小李，大家都来了。
items.py: chú le xiǎo lǐ dà jiā dōu lái le
items.en: Everyone came except Xiao Li.
items.why: 'All except' is 除了 + 都, with 都 after the subject 大家. The sentence is correct.

items.q: 要是你的表格明天上午还没交，经理___会不高兴的。
items.zh: 要是你的表格明天上午还没交，经理就会不高兴的。
items.py: yào shì nǐ de biǎo gé míng tiān shàng wǔ hái méi jiāo jīng lǐ jiù huì bù gāo xìng de
items.en: If your form still hasn't been handed in by tomorrow morning, the manager will be unhappy.
items.why: 要是 pairs with 就 after the second subject 经理. 才 would say 'only then', and 都 or 却 do not complete an if-clause.

items.q: ___你把文件发给我，___我明天去你办公室拿。
items.zh: 要么你把文件发给我，要么我明天去你办公室拿。
items.py: yào me nǐ bǎ wén jiàn fā gěi wǒ yào me wǒ míng tiān qù nǐ bàn gōng shì ná
items.en: Either you send me the file, or I'll come to your office tomorrow to pick it up.
items.why: Two options offered for the listener to choose from are 要么…要么. 不是…就是 states what is always the case, and 不是…而是 corrects a mistake.

items.s: 不管多忙，他都会给家人打电话。
items.s_py: bù guǎn duō máng tā dōu huì gěi jiā rén dǎ diàn huà
items.zh: 不管多忙，他都会给家人打电话。
items.py: bù guǎn duō máng tā dōu huì gěi jiā rén dǎ diàn huà
items.en: However busy he is, he always phones his family.
items.why: 多忙 ('how busy') is the open question 不管 needs, and 都 follows the subject 他. The sentence is correct.

items.s: 他一边走路一边打电话。
items.s_py: tā yī biān zǒu lù yī biān dǎ diàn huà
items.zh: 他一边走路一边打电话。
items.py: tā yī biān zǒu lù yī biān dǎ diàn huà
items.en: He talks on the phone while walking.
items.why: Two actions at the same time take 一边…一边, each right before its verb. The sentence is correct.

items.s: 除了周六，同学们每天还来教室。
items.s_py: chú le zhōu liù tóng xué men měi tiān hái lái jiào shì
items.zh: 除了周六，同学们每天都来教室。
items.py: chú le zhōu liù tóng xué men měi tiān dōu lái jiào shì
items.en: The students come to the classroom every day except Saturday.
items.why: Saturday is the exception, so the partner is 都. 还 means 'also' and would add Saturday instead of excluding it.

items.s: 只有经理同意，这个计划才能开始。
items.s_py: zhǐ yǒu jīng lǐ tóng yì zhè ge jì huà cái néng kāi shǐ
items.zh: 只有经理同意，这个计划才能开始。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu jīng lǐ tóng yì zhè ge jì huà cái néng kāi shǐ
items.en: This plan can only start if the manager agrees.
items.why: 只有 is answered by 才 after the subject 这个计划, and 就 is not allowed. The sentence is correct.

items.q: 除了小李，我们班的同学___参加了比赛。
items.zh: 除了小李，我们班的同学都参加了比赛。
items.py: chú le xiǎo lǐ wǒ men bān de tóng xué dōu cān jiā le bǐ sài
items.en: Everyone in our class took part in the competition except Xiao Li.
items.why: 'Everyone except Xiao Li' is 除了 + 都. 还 and 也 would say 'besides Xiao Li, the others also took part', and 才 means 'only then'.

items.q: 不管公司给的工资多高，他___不愿意离开家乡。
items.zh: 不管公司给的工资多高，他都不愿意离开家乡。
items.py: bù guǎn gōng sī gěi de gōng zī duō gāo tā dōu bù yuàn yì lí kāi jiā xiāng
items.en: No matter how high a salary the company offers, he is unwilling to leave his hometown.
items.why: 不管 + 多高 (open question) is answered by 都 after the subject 他. 就 and 才 belong to if and only-if sentences, and 却 would give a contrast without the 'any case' meaning.

items.zh: 既然你已经同意了，我们就开始吧。
items.py: jì rán nǐ yǐ jīng tóng yì le wǒ men jiù kāi shǐ ba
items.en: Since you've already agreed, let's start.
items.why: 既然 takes 就 after the second subject 我们, with no 所以 in between. 就 cannot move in front of 我们.

items.q: 他既会写程序，___会做设计。
items.zh: 他既会写程序，又会做设计。
items.py: tā jì huì xiě chéng xù yòu huì zuò shè jì
items.en: He can both write programs and do design.
items.why: 既…又 joins two abilities in the same pattern: 既会…又会…. 就 and 才 are condition partners, and 但 would mark a contrast.

items.s: 小王又聪明也努力。
items.s_py: xiǎo wáng yòu cōng ming yě nǔ lì
items.zh: 小王又聪明又努力。
items.py: xiǎo wáng yòu cōng ming yòu nǔ lì
items.en: Xiao Wang is both clever and hardworking.
items.why: 又 pairs with another 又 here. 也 cannot be the partner of 又 in this pattern.

items.q: 既然你已经做完作业了，我们___去看电影吧。
items.zh: 既然你已经做完作业了，我们就去看电影吧。
items.py: jì rán nǐ yǐ jīng zuò wán zuò yè le wǒ men jiù qù kàn diàn yǐng ba
items.en: Since you've finished your homework, let's go and see a film.
items.why: 既然 (since) takes 就 after the second subject 我们 and leads to a suggestion. 才 would mean 'only then', which clashes with a plain suggestion; 都 and 却 do not link a suggestion to a known fact.

items.s: 因为通过考试，他每天复习到很晚。
items.s_py: yīn wèi tōng guò kǎo shì tā měi tiān fù xí dào hěn wǎn
items.zh: 为了通过考试，他每天复习到很晚。
items.py: wèi le tōng guò kǎo shì tā měi tiān fù xí dào hěn wǎn
items.en: He revises until late every day in order to pass the exam.
items.why: Passing the exam is the goal of the revision, not its cause, so 为了 is needed. 因为 would claim the exam was already passed.

items.q: 即使老板不同意，我___要把这个方案做完。
items.zh: 即使老板不同意，我也要把这个方案做完。
items.py: jí shǐ lǎo bǎn bù tóng yì wǒ yě yào bǎ zhè ge fāng àn zuò wán
items.en: Even if the boss doesn't agree, I'm going to finish this plan.
items.why: 即使 supposes a case and takes 也 after the second subject 我. 才 means 'only then', and 所以 or 而且 are conjunctions that give cause or addition instead of 'even so'.

items.zh: 你先写名字，再填电话号码。
items.py: nǐ xiān xiě míng zì zài tián diàn huà hào mǎ
items.en: Write your name first, then fill in your phone number.
items.why: 先 marks the first step and 再 the second; both are adverbs right before their verbs, so 再 cannot stand before the subject 你 or at the end.

items.s: 只要你认真准备，就一定能通过面试。
items.s_py: zhǐ yào nǐ rèn zhēn zhǔn bèi jiù yí dìng néng tōng guò miàn shì
items.zh: 只要你认真准备，就一定能通过面试。
items.py: zhǐ yào nǐ rèn zhēn zhǔn bèi jiù yí dìng néng tōng guò miàn shì
items.en: As long as you prepare carefully, you'll certainly pass the interview.
items.why: The second clause shares the subject 你, so 就 simply opens it and needs no subject in front. The sentence is correct.

items.zh: 他的汉字写得越来越好了。
items.py: tā de hàn zì xiě de yuè lái yuè hǎo le
items.en: His Chinese characters are getting better and better.
items.why: 越来越 stands right before the adjective 好 with no 很, and 了 at the end marks the change over time.

items.src_py: zhè jiān jiào shì hěn dà yě hěn liàng
items.zh: 这间教室又大又亮。
items.py: zhè jiān jiào shì yòu dà yòu liàng
items.en: This classroom is both big and bright.
items.why: 又…又 joins two bare adjectives, so 很 and 也 are dropped.

items.q: 我越来越___这份工作了。
items.zh: 我越来越喜欢这份工作了。
items.py: wǒ yuè lái yuè xǐ huan zhè fèn gōng zuò le
items.en: I like this job more and more.
items.why: 越来越 can take a feeling verb such as 喜欢, but no degree word. 很 and 特别 duplicate the degree, and 越 is already inside 越来越.

items.q: 只有经理签字，这份合同___有效。
items.zh: 只有经理签字，这份合同才有效。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu jīng lǐ qiān zì zhè fèn hé tóng cái yǒu xiào
items.en: This contract is valid only if the manager signs it.
items.why: 'Only if the manager signs' is 只有 + 才. 就 would make the signature one of several enough conditions, which is the meaning of 只要.

items.zh: 为了提高成绩，同学们每天都复习。
items.py: wèi le tí gāo chéng jì tóng xué men měi tiān dōu fù xí
items.en: To raise their grades, the students review every day.
items.why: 为了 + goal gives the purpose of the action and stands before the main verb phrase. 都 follows 每天 and stands right before 复习.

items.src_py: zuì jìn wǒ de gōng zuò hěn máng
items.task: Say it is getting busier and busier.
items.zh: 最近，我的工作越来越忙了。
items.py: zuì jìn wǒ de gōng zuò yuè lái yuè máng le
items.en: My work has been getting busier and busier lately.
items.why: 越来越 replaces 很 and sits right before the adjective; 了 at the end marks the change. 很 cannot stay.

items.q: 这个会议室又大___亮。
items.zh: 这个会议室又大又亮。
items.py: zhè ge huì yì shì yòu dà yòu liàng
items.en: This meeting room is both big and bright.
items.why: 又…又 joins two qualities of the same thing: 又大又亮. 也, 还 and 再 do not pair with the first 又.

items.q: 因为妈妈今天生病了，___我自己做晚饭。
items.zh: 因为妈妈今天生病了，所以我自己做晚饭。
items.py: yīn wèi mā ma jīn tiān shēng bìng le suǒ yǐ wǒ zì jǐ zuò wǎn fàn
items.en: Because Mum is ill today, I'm making dinner myself.
items.why: 因为 introduces the cause and 所以 introduces the result, in front of the second subject. 但是 would set up a contrast and 如果 a supposition, but this is a real reason.

items.q: ___我们家离学校很近，___我每天走路上学。
items.zh: 因为我们家离学校很近，所以我每天走路上学。
items.py: yīn wèi wǒ men jiā lí xué xiào hěn jìn suǒ yǐ wǒ měi tiān zǒu lù shàng xué
items.en: Because our home is close to school, I walk to school every day.
items.why: A real reason and its result: 因为 then 所以. 虽然…但是 would make the second clause a contrast, and 如果 or 只要 would turn the cause into a condition.

items.q: ___让女儿安静地学习，爸爸把电视关了。
items.zh: 为了让女儿安静地学习，爸爸把电视关了。
items.py: wèi le ràng nǚ ér ān jìng de xué xí bà ba bǎ diàn shì guān le
items.en: In order to let his daughter study in peace, Dad turned the TV off.
items.why: The first clause gives the goal Dad had in mind, so it takes 为了. 由于 and 既然 give a cause or known fact, and 如果 a supposition, none of which fit a purpose.

items.q: 既然这个手机已经坏了，我们___买一个新的吧。
items.zh: 既然这个手机已经坏了，我们就买一个新的吧。
items.py: jì rán zhè ge shǒu jī yǐ jīng huài le wǒ men jiù mǎi yī ge xīn de ba
items.en: Since this phone is already broken, let's buy a new one.
items.why: 既然 (since, given that) takes 就 after the second subject for a suggestion. 所以 and 可是 cannot follow 我们 here, and 才 would mean 'only then'.

items.q: 由于天气太冷，超市里的青菜卖得很贵，___很多人都不买。
items.zh: 由于天气太冷，超市里的青菜卖得很贵，因此很多人都不买。
items.py: yóu yú tiān qì tài lěng chāo shì lǐ de qīng cài mài de hěn guì yīn cǐ hěn duō rén dōu bù mǎi
items.en: Owing to the cold weather, greens are expensive in the supermarket, and therefore many people don't buy them.
items.why: The formal 由于 is answered by 因此 at the head of the result clause. 因为 would reverse cause and result, and 如果 or 虽然 would change the logic.

items.q: 既然你答应了孩子，你___应该带他去公园玩。
items.zh: 既然你答应了孩子，你就应该带他去公园玩。
items.py: jì rán nǐ dā ying le hái zi nǐ jiù yīng gāi dài tā qù gōng yuán wán
items.en: Since you promised the child, you should take him to the park.
items.why: 既然 leads to a conclusion with 就, and 就 stands after the subject 你. 所以, 可是 and 因此 are conjunctions and cannot sit between 你 and 应该.

items.q: ___这件衣服很便宜，___我不喜欢。
items.zh: 虽然这件衣服很便宜，但是我不喜欢。
items.py: suī rán zhè jiàn yī fu hěn pián yi dàn shì wǒ bù xǐ huan
items.en: Although this piece of clothing is cheap, I don't like it.
items.why: A real fact followed by an unexpected result takes 虽然…但是. 不但…而且 adds a second similar point, and 如果 or 只要 would make 便宜 a condition.

items.q: 虽然哥哥很忙，___他每天给奶奶打电话。
items.zh: 虽然哥哥很忙，但是他每天给奶奶打电话。
items.py: suī rán gē ge hěn máng dàn shì tā měi tiān gěi nǎi nai dǎ diàn huà
items.en: Although my brother is busy, he phones Grandma every day.
items.why: 虽然 needs 但是 in the second clause, in front of 他. 所以 would claim that being busy causes the calls, and 而且 and 然后 do not mark a contrast.

items.q: ___明天商店不打折，妈妈___会去买那双鞋。
items.zh: 即使明天商店不打折，妈妈也会去买那双鞋。
items.py: jí shǐ míng tiān shāng diàn bù dǎ zhé mā ma yě huì qù mǎi nà shuāng xié
items.en: Even if the shop has no sale tomorrow, Mum will still go and buy those shoes.
items.why: 明天 has not happened, so this is a supposed case: 即使…也. 虽然…但是 needs a fact that already exists, and 因为…所以 would state a cause.

items.q: 尽管鞋子很贵，奶奶___买给孙女了。
items.zh: 尽管鞋子很贵，奶奶还是买给孙女了。
items.py: jǐn guǎn xié zi hěn guì nǎi nai hái shi mǎi gěi sūn nǚ le
items.en: Even though the shoes were expensive, Grandma bought them for her granddaughter anyway.
items.why: 尽管 states a real fact and its partner is 还是 after the second subject. 才 and 就 do not express 'anyway', and 所以 would make the high price the reason for buying.

items.q: 就算你不说，爸爸___知道钱是你拿的。
items.zh: 就算你不说，爸爸也知道钱是你拿的。
items.py: jiù suàn nǐ bù shuō bà ba yě zhī dào qián shì nǐ ná de
items.en: Even if you don't say, Dad knows it was you who took the money.
items.why: 就算 (even if) takes 也 after the second subject. 但是 belongs with 虽然 and cannot follow 爸爸, and 才 or 所以 give the wrong logic.

items.q: ___家里已经有两台冰箱了，___妈妈还想再买一台。
items.zh: 虽然家里已经有两台冰箱了，但是妈妈还想再买一台。
items.py: suī rán jiā lǐ yǐ jīng yǒu liǎng tái bīng xiāng le dàn shì mā ma hái xiǎng zài mǎi yī tái
items.en: Although we already have two fridges at home, Mum still wants to buy another.
items.why: The two fridges are an existing fact that Mum ignores, so 虽然…但是. 只要, 如果 and 只有 all need a condition, and the second clause would not be a surprise.

items.q: 即使以后你搬到别的城市，爸爸妈妈___会常常给你打电话。
items.zh: 即使以后你搬到别的城市，爸爸妈妈也会常常给你打电话。
items.py: jí shǐ yǐ hòu nǐ bān dào bié de chéng shì bà ba mā ma yě huì cháng cháng gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
items.en: Even if you move to another city later, Mum and Dad will still call you often.
items.why: 即使 sets up a supposed future case and takes 也 after the second subject. 就 and 才 do not give 'still', and 却 needs a fact, not a supposition.

items.q: 只有你陪着，奶奶___愿意去医院。
items.zh: 只有你陪着，奶奶才愿意去医院。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu nǐ péi zhe nǎi nai cái yuàn yì qù yī yuàn
items.en: Grandma is only willing to go to the hospital if you go with her.
items.why: 只有 names the one condition that works, and its partner is 才. 就 belongs with 只要 and 如果.

items.q: 只要价格便宜，我___买。
items.zh: 只要价格便宜，我就买。
items.py: zhǐ yào jià gé pián yi wǒ jiù mǎi
items.en: As long as the price is cheap, I'll buy it.
items.why: 只要 (as long as) is paired with 就 after the second subject. 才 would turn the sentence into 'only if'.

items.q: 如果东西坏了，商店___给你换新的。
items.zh: 如果东西坏了，商店就会给你换新的。
items.py: rú guǒ dōng xi huài le shāng diàn jiù huì gěi nǐ huàn xīn de
items.en: If the item is broken, the shop will swap it for a new one.
items.why: 如果 takes 就 after the second subject 商店. 才会 would mean 'only then', and 所以 and 但是 cannot follow a subject.

items.q: ___你把作业写完，妈妈才让你看电视。
items.zh: 只有你把作业写完，妈妈才让你看电视。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu nǐ bǎ zuò yè xiě wán mā ma cái ràng nǐ kàn diàn shì
items.en: Only when you have finished your homework will Mum let you watch TV.
items.why: The 才 already in the sentence calls for 只有, the one condition that works. 只要 pairs with 就, and 虽然 or 既然 do not set a condition.

items.q: ___爸爸点头，妈妈就同意了。
items.zh: 只要爸爸点头，妈妈就同意了。
items.py: zhǐ yào bà ba diǎn tóu mā ma jiù tóng yì le
items.en: As long as Dad nodded, Mum agreed.
items.why: The 就 in the second clause points to 只要 (this one condition is enough). 只有 needs 才, and 虽然 or 即使 would not fit 就 here.

items.q: ___你能在六点前回家，我们___能一起去看电影。
items.zh: 只有你能在六点前回家，我们才能一起去看电影。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu nǐ néng zài liù diǎn qián huí jiā wǒ men cái néng yī qǐ qù kàn diàn yǐng
items.en: Only if you can be home before six can we go to the cinema together.
items.why: 'Only if' is 只有…才. 只要…就 would say that being home by six is enough, and the mixed pairs 只有…就 and 如果…才 do not exist.

items.q: 要是这家超市每天都打折的话，妈妈___会天天来买菜。
items.zh: 要是这家超市每天都打折的话，妈妈就会天天来买菜。
items.py: yào shi zhè jiā chāo shì měi tiān dōu dǎ zhé de huà mā ma jiù huì tiān tiān lái mǎi cài
items.en: If this supermarket had a sale every day, Mum would come to buy vegetables every day.
items.why: 要是…的话 takes 就 after the second subject. 才 belongs with 只有, and 可是 or 然后 cannot stand after 妈妈.

items.q: 除了爸爸，我们家的人___爱吃鱼。
items.zh: 除了爸爸，我们家的人都爱吃鱼。
items.py: chú le bà ba wǒ men jiā de rén dōu ài chī yú
items.en: Everyone in our family loves fish except Dad.
items.why: 'Except' is 除了…都. 还 would add to Dad, giving 'besides Dad, the others also...', which is not what is said here.

items.q: 不管价格___，姐姐都想买这条裙子。
items.zh: 不管价格贵不贵，姐姐都想买这条裙子。
items.py: bù guǎn jià gé guì bu guì jiě jie dōu xiǎng mǎi zhè tiáo qún zi
items.en: Whether the price is high or not, my sister wants to buy this skirt.
items.why: 不管 must be followed by an open question form, here the A-not-A 贵不贵. A plain statement such as 很贵 or 太贵 leaves nothing open.

items.q: 无论天气怎么样，爷爷每天早上___去公园。
items.zh: 无论天气怎么样，爷爷每天早上都去公园。
items.py: wú lùn tiān qì zěn me yàng yé ye měi tiān zǎo shang dōu qù gōng yuán
items.en: Whatever the weather is like, Grandpa goes to the park every morning.
items.why: 无论 plus an open question is answered by 都 after the second subject. 才 means 'only then', and 所以 cannot follow 每天早上.

items.q: 除了牛奶以外，妈妈___买了一些水果。
items.zh: 除了牛奶以外，妈妈还买了一些水果。
items.py: chú le niú nǎi yǐ wài mā ma hái mǎi le yī xiē shuǐ guǒ
items.en: Besides milk, Mum also bought some fruit.
items.why: 'Besides A, also B' is 除了…还. 都 would have to mean 'all except', which cannot work with a single purchase of 一些水果.

items.q: 除了星期天，这家商店每天___开门。
items.zh: 除了星期天，这家商店每天都开门。
items.py: chú le xīng qī tiān zhè jiā shāng diàn měi tiān dōu kāi mén
items.en: The shop is open every day except Sunday.
items.why: Sunday is left out, so the partner is 都 after 每天. 还 would mean 'in addition to Sunday', which makes no sense with 每天.

items.q: 不管是大人___孩子，在家里都要自己洗碗。
items.zh: 不管是大人还是孩子，在家里都要自己洗碗。
items.py: bù guǎn shì dà rén hái shi hái zi zài jiā lǐ dōu yào zì jǐ xǐ wǎn
items.en: Whether adults or children, everyone at home has to wash their own bowls.
items.why: 不管 needs the question form A 还是 B, which gives two open choices. 而且, 所以 and 然后 cannot link two alternatives.

items.q: 无论你想买___，妈妈都会先看看价格。
items.zh: 无论你想买什么，妈妈都会先看看价格。
items.py: wú lùn nǐ xiǎng mǎi shén me mā ma dōu huì xiān kàn kan jià gé
items.en: Whatever you want to buy, Mum will check the price first.
items.why: 无论 needs a question word. 什么 makes the object open; 东西, 一个 and 很多 are plain statements and cannot follow 无论.

items.q: 这家饭馆的菜___好吃___便宜。
items.zh: 这家饭馆的菜又好吃又便宜。
items.py: zhè jiā fàn guǎn de cài yòu hǎo chī yòu pián yi
items.en: The food in this restaurant is both tasty and cheap.
items.why: Two qualities of the same thing are joined by 又…又. 一边…一边 is for two actions happening at once.

items.q: 奶奶一边包饺子，___和孙子聊天。
items.zh: 奶奶一边包饺子，一边和孙子聊天。
items.py: nǎi nai yī biān bāo jiǎo zi yī biān hé sūn zi liáo tiān
items.en: Grandma chats with her grandson while making dumplings.
items.why: Two actions at the same time take 一边…一边, and the second 一边 stands right before the verb phrase. 又 would join qualities, and 先 or 才 would not mean 'at the same time'.

items.q: 这条裙子又___又好看。
items.zh: 这条裙子又便宜又好看。
items.py: zhè tiáo qún zi yòu pián yi yòu hǎo kàn
items.en: This skirt is both cheap and pretty.
items.why: Inside 又…又 the adjectives stay bare. 很, 太 or 非常 cannot be added between 又 and the adjective.

items.q: 妈妈既要上班，___要照顾孩子，每天都很累。
items.zh: 妈妈既要上班，又要照顾孩子，每天都很累。
items.py: mā ma jì yào shàng bān yòu yào zhào gù hái zi měi tiān dōu hěn lèi
items.en: Mum both has to work and look after the children, so she is tired every day.
items.why: 既 is matched with 又 (or 也) before the second verb phrase. 就, 才 and 而是 cannot complete 既.

items.q: 不但哥哥喜欢这个游戏，___弟弟也很喜欢。
items.zh: 不但哥哥喜欢这个游戏，而且弟弟也很喜欢。
items.py: bù dàn gē ge xǐ huan zhè ge yóu xì ér qiě dì di yě hěn xǐ huan
items.en: Not only my elder brother likes this game; my younger brother likes it a lot too.
items.why: The second clause has its own subject 弟弟, so the conjunction 而且 must stand in front of it. 还 is an adverb and cannot precede 弟弟.

items.q: 这件外套不但很便宜，___很暖和。
items.zh: 这件外套不但很便宜，还很暖和。
items.py: zhè jiàn wài tào bù dàn hěn pián yi hái hěn nuǎn huo
items.en: This coat is not only cheap, it is also very warm.
items.why: The shared subject 这件外套 is not repeated, so the adverb 还 opens the second part. 而是, 但是 and 所以 would change the meaning.

items.q: 他___是我的邻居，___是我最好的朋友。
items.zh: 他既是我的邻居，也是我最好的朋友。
items.py: tā jì shì wǒ de lín jū yě shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péng you
items.en: He is both my neighbour and my best friend.
items.why: 既…也 joins two identities of the same person. 一边…一边 is only for actions at the same time, and the others set up a condition or contrast.

items.q: 你先把钱付了，___拿东西。
items.zh: 你先把钱付了，再拿东西。
items.py: nǐ xiān bǎ qián fù le zài ná dōng xi
items.en: Pay first, then take the things.
items.why: 先…再 marks two steps in order. 都 and 也 do not mark a second step, and 所以 would make the first step a cause.

items.q: 爸爸一回家，我们___吃饭。
items.zh: 爸爸一回家，我们就吃饭。
items.py: bà ba yī huí jiā wǒ men jiù chī fàn
items.en: As soon as Dad gets home, we eat.
items.why: 一…就 means 'as soon as'. 才 would mean 'not until', and 再 or 又 do not pair with 一.

items.q: 他___下班就去超市买菜。
items.zh: 他一下班就去超市买菜。
items.py: tā yī xià bān jiù qù chāo shì mǎi cài
items.en: As soon as he finishes work he goes to the supermarket to buy food.
items.why: 一 goes before the first verb and is answered by 就. 先 or 再 do not combine with 就 to mean 'as soon as'.

items.q: 她___走进商店，___看见了那条红裙子。
items.zh: 她一走进商店，就看见了那条红裙子。
items.py: tā yī zǒu jìn shāng diàn jiù kàn jiàn le nà tiáo hóng qún zi
items.en: As soon as she walked into the shop, she saw that red dress.
items.why: 'As soon as' is 一…就. 先…再 would suggest she planned two steps, but seeing the dress is not a planned step.

items.q: 弟弟一看见玩具，___想让妈妈买。
items.zh: 弟弟一看见玩具，就想让妈妈买。
items.py: dì di yī kàn jiàn wán jù jiù xiǎng ràng mā ma mǎi
items.en: As soon as my little brother sees a toy, he wants Mum to buy it.
items.why: 一 + verb is always answered by 就 before the next verb. 才 would mean 'not until', and 再 or 也 do not fit.

items.q: 我们先去银行取钱，___去超市买东西。
items.zh: 我们先去银行取钱，然后去超市买东西。
items.py: wǒ men xiān qù yín háng qǔ qián rán hòu qù chāo shì mǎi dōng xi
items.en: We'll go to the bank to get money first, and then go shopping at the supermarket.
items.why: 先 opens the sequence and 然后 introduces the next step. 所以, 可是 and 因为 would give cause or contrast between the two trips.

items.q: 你先把衣服洗干净，___晾在外面。
items.zh: 你先把衣服洗干净，再晾在外面。
items.py: nǐ xiān bǎ yī fu xǐ gān jìng zài liàng zài wài miàn
items.en: First wash the clothes clean, then hang them outside.
items.why: 先 is followed by 再 for the second step. 还, 更 and 最 are degree or addition adverbs and do not mark a later step.

items.q: 天气越来越___了，我们去买厚衣服吧。
items.zh: 天气越来越冷了，我们去买厚衣服吧。
items.py: tiān qì yuè lái yuè lěng le wǒ men qù mǎi hòu yī fu ba
items.en: The weather is getting colder and colder; let's go and buy thick clothes.
items.why: 越来越 is followed by a bare adjective. 很, 太 and 非常 add a degree that 越来越 already expresses.

items.q: 这个孩子越长越___，已经比爸爸高了。
items.zh: 这个孩子越长越高，已经比爸爸高了。
items.py: zhè ge hái zi yuè zhǎng yuè gāo yǐ jīng bǐ bà ba gāo le
items.en: This child gets taller as he grows; he is already taller than his dad.
items.why: 越 + verb + 越 + adjective takes a bare adjective as the second part. 很, 更 and 太 cannot follow 越.

items.q: 这件衣服我___穿___喜欢。
items.zh: 这件衣服我越穿越喜欢。
items.py: zhè jiàn yī fu wǒ yuè chuān yuè xǐ huan
items.en: The more I wear this top, the more I like it.
items.why: The verb 穿 sits between the two parts, which is the 越…越 frame. 越来越 stands before one adjective or feeling verb and cannot surround a verb.

items.q: 雨___下___大，我们别去超市了。
items.zh: 雨越下越大，我们别去超市了。
items.py: yǔ yuè xià yuè dà wǒ men bié qù chāo shì le
items.en: The rain is getting heavier and heavier; let's not go to the supermarket.
items.why: The verb 下 stands between the two 越, giving 越下越大. 越来越 cannot be placed before the verb 下.

items.q: 妈妈做的菜越来越___，全家人都爱吃。
items.zh: 妈妈做的菜越来越好吃，全家人都爱吃。
items.py: mā ma zuò de cài yuè lái yuè hǎo chī quán jiā rén dōu ài chī
items.en: Mum's cooking is getting better and better and the whole family loves it.
items.why: 越来越 takes a bare adjective. 很, 非常 and 更 would double the degree, which is not allowed.

items.q: 你___着急，___容易出错，慢慢来吧。
items.zh: 你越着急，越容易出错，慢慢来吧。
items.py: nǐ yuè zháo jí yuè róng yì chū cuò màn màn lái ba
items.en: The more anxious you are, the easier it is to make mistakes; take it slowly.
items.why: Two linked changes, one growing with the other, are 越…越. 越来越 describes one thing changing over time, and 又…又 would only list two qualities.

items.q: 他买的不是苹果，___梨。
items.zh: 他买的不是苹果，而是梨。
items.py: tā mǎi de bù shì píng guǒ ér shì lí
items.en: What he bought was not apples but pears.
items.why: The sentence corrects A with B, so it is 不是…而是. 就是 would say it must be one of the two, and 要么 offers a choice.

items.q: 妈妈不是去超市买东西，___去银行取钱。
items.zh: 妈妈不是去超市买东西，而是去银行取钱。
items.py: mā ma bù shì qù chāo shì mǎi dōng xi ér shì qù yín háng qǔ qián
items.en: Mum isn't going to the supermarket to shop; she is going to the bank to get money.
items.why: A correction ('not A but B') takes 而是. 就是 would claim she always does one or the other, and 要么 offers options.

items.q: ___你自己去买，___让我去买，别再吵了。
items.zh: 要么你自己去买，要么让我去买，别再吵了。
items.py: yào me nǐ zì jǐ qù mǎi yào me ràng wǒ qù mǎi bié zài chǎo le
items.en: Either you go and buy it yourself or let me go; stop arguing.
items.why: Two options to choose between are 要么…要么. 不是…而是 would be a correction, and 不但…而且 an addition.

items.q: 周末弟弟不是在家看电视，___在房间玩游戏，从来不出门。
items.zh: 周末弟弟不是在家看电视，就是在房间玩游戏，从来不出门。
items.py: zhōu mò dì di bù shì zài jiā kàn diàn shì jiù shì zài fáng jiān wán yóu xì cóng lái bù chū mén
items.en: At weekends my brother is always either watching TV at home or playing games in his room; he never goes out.
items.why: 'Always one or the other' is 不是…就是. 而是 would correct a claim ('not A but B'), which does not fit the habitual cue.

items.q: 既然你不想去，___自己去了。
items.zh: 既然你不想去，我就自己去了。
items.py: jì rán nǐ bù xiǎng qù wǒ jiù zì jǐ qù le
items.en: Since you don't want to go, I'll go by myself.
items.why: 就 is an adverb and goes after the second subject: 我就. 就我 puts it in front of the subject, which is never correct.

items.q: 虽然这个钱包很旧，___还很好用。
items.zh: 虽然这个钱包很旧，但是它还很好用。
items.py: suī rán zhè ge qián bāo hěn jiù dàn shì tā hái hěn hǎo yòng
items.en: Although this wallet is old, it is still very useful.
items.why: 但是 is a conjunction and stands before the second subject: 但是它. After the subject it would be wrong, and 所以 or 因此 give the wrong logic.

items.q: 不管天气怎么样，___去市场买菜。
items.zh: 不管天气怎么样，奶奶都去市场买菜。
items.py: bù guǎn tiān qì zěn me yàng nǎi nai dōu qù shì chǎng mǎi cài
items.en: Whatever the weather, Grandma goes to the market to buy food.
items.why: The partner of 不管 is 都, and it follows the subject: 奶奶都去. 都奶奶 is out of order, and 才 or 就 do not pair with 不管.

items.q: 只有你同意，___能买这台洗衣机。
items.zh: 只有你同意，我们才能买这台洗衣机。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu nǐ tóng yì wǒ men cái néng mǎi zhè tái xǐ yī jī
items.en: We can buy this washing machine only if you agree.
items.why: 只有 takes 才, and 才 sits after the second subject: 我们才. 才我们 and 就我们 put the adverb before the subject, and 就 does not go with 只有.

items.zh: 如果孩子不想去，我们就不去了。
items.py: rú guǒ hái zi bù xiǎng qù wǒ men jiù bù qù le
items.en: If the child doesn't want to go, we won't go.
items.why: 就 is an adverb and follows the second subject 我们. 如果 may stand before or after 孩子.

items.zh: 只有你亲自去，他才会同意。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu nǐ qīn zì qù tā cái huì tóng yì
items.en: Only if you go in person will he agree.
items.why: 只有 is answered by 才, which comes after the second subject 他 and before the verb. 就 would be the wrong partner.

items.zh: 因为下雨，所以我们没去超市。
items.py: yīn wèi xià yǔ suǒ yǐ wǒ men méi qù chāo shì
items.en: Because it rained, we didn't go to the supermarket.
items.why: 因为 opens the reason clause and 所以 opens the result clause, in front of the subject 我们.

items.zh: 虽然这个包很贵，但是妈妈还是买了。
items.py: suī rán zhè ge bāo hěn guì dàn shì mā ma hái shi mǎi le
items.en: Although this bag is expensive, Mum bought it anyway.
items.why: 但是 comes before the second subject 妈妈, while 还是 comes after it. 虽然 may precede or follow 这个包.

items.zh: 除了爷爷，我们都喜欢吃鱼。
items.py: chú le yé ye wǒ men dōu xǐ huan chī yú
items.en: All of us like fish except Grandpa.
items.why: 'Except' pairs 除了 with 都, and 都 comes after 我们. 除了爷爷 may also follow 我们.

items.zh: 这件衣服又便宜又好看。
items.py: zhè jiàn yī fu yòu pián yi yòu hǎo kàn
items.en: This piece of clothing is both cheap and good-looking.
items.why: 又…又 joins two qualities, each 又 directly before its adjective, with no 很. The two adjectives can swap places.

items.zh: 他一下班就去买菜。
items.py: tā yī xià bān jiù qù mǎi cài
items.en: He goes to buy groceries as soon as he finishes work.
items.why: 一 comes right before 下班 and 就 right before 去. The subject 他 is normally said once, before 一, though it may also follow the 一下班 phrase.

items.zh: 你先把鞋脱了，再进房间。
items.py: nǐ xiān bǎ xié tuō le zài jìn fáng jiān
items.en: Take your shoes off first, then go into the room.
items.why: 先 marks the first step and 再 the next, both after the subject and before their verb phrases.

items.zh: 妈妈越说，孩子越不听。
items.py: mā ma yuè shuō hái zi yuè bù tīng
items.en: The more Mum talks, the less the child listens.
items.why: In 越…越 each 越 sits directly before its verb, one in each clause, each after its own subject.

items.zh: 他不是我的哥哥，而是我的表哥。
items.py: tā bù shì wǒ de gē ge ér shì wǒ de biǎo gē
items.en: He is not my brother but my cousin.
items.why: A correction is 不是 A 而是 B, with 而是 right in front of the corrected part.

items.zh: 周末妈妈不是逛街，就是在家做饭。
items.py: zhōu mò mā ma bù shì guàng jiē jiù shì zài jiā zuò fàn
items.en: At weekends Mum is always either out shopping or cooking at home.
items.why: 不是 A 就是 B says it is always one of the two. The time word 周末 can come before or after 妈妈.

items.zh: 只要价格合适，我们就买。
items.py: zhǐ yào jià gé hé shì wǒ men jiù mǎi
items.en: As long as the price is right, we'll buy it.
items.why: 就 is an adverb that follows the second subject 我们. 只要 may come before or after 价格, and 我们 may also open the sentence.

items.zh: 不管价格高不高，爸爸都要买这台冰箱。
items.py: bù guǎn jià gé gāo bu gāo bà ba dōu yào mǎi zhè tái bīng xiāng
items.en: Whether the price is high or not, Dad wants to buy this fridge.
items.why: 不管 needs an A-not-A question (高不高) and 都 after the subject 爸爸. 爸爸 may also open the sentence.

items.zh: 除了水果，妈妈还买了牛奶。
items.py: chú le shuǐ guǒ mā ma hái mǎi le niú nǎi
items.en: Besides fruit, Mum also bought milk.
items.why: 'Besides A, also B' is 除了…还, with 还 after the subject. 除了水果 may also follow 妈妈.

items.zh: 不但弟弟爱玩游戏，而且妹妹也爱玩。
items.py: bù dàn dì di ài wán yóu xì ér qiě mèi mei yě ài wán
items.en: Not only does my younger brother love playing games, my younger sister loves it too.
items.why: The clauses have different subjects, so 不但 comes before the first subject and 而且 before the second.

items.zh: 姐姐一边做饭一边听音乐。
items.py: jiě jie yī biān zuò fàn yī biān tīng yīn yuè
items.en: My elder sister listens to music while she cooks.
items.why: 一边…一边 puts each 一边 directly before its verb, with the subject first.

items.zh: 为了让孩子吃得健康，妈妈每天都自己做饭。
items.py: wèi le ràng hái zi chī de jiàn kāng mā ma měi tiān dōu zì jǐ zuò fàn
items.en: To make sure her child eats healthily, Mum cooks the meals herself every day.
items.why: 为了 opens the goal clause. 都 follows 每天 and comes before the verb phrase. 每天 may come before or after 妈妈.

items.zh: 既然你不舒服，就别去上班了。
items.py: jì rán nǐ bù shū fu jiù bié qù shàng bān le
items.en: Since you're not feeling well, don't go to work.
items.why: 既然 leads to a suggestion with 就, which stands directly before the verb phrase. 既然 may come before or after 你.

items.zh: 即使明天商店不打折，我也要去。
items.py: jí shǐ míng tiān shāng diàn bù dǎ zhé wǒ yě yào qù
items.en: Even if the shop has no sale tomorrow, I'm going.
items.why: 即使 sets up the supposed case and 也 follows the second subject 我. 我 may also precede 即使.

items.src: 大家都喜欢吃辣，爷爷不喜欢。
items.src_py: dà jiā dōu xǐ huan chī là yé ye bù xǐ huan
items.zh: 除了爷爷，大家都喜欢吃辣。
items.py: chú le yé ye dà jiā dōu xǐ huan chī là
items.en: Everyone likes spicy food except Grandpa.
items.why: 'Everyone except Grandpa' is 除了 A, with 都 after the subject 大家. The phrase 除了爷爷 can also follow 大家.

items.src_py: mā ma huí jiā hòu mǎ shàng zuò fàn
items.zh: 妈妈一回家就做饭。
items.py: mā ma yī huí jiā jiù zuò fàn
items.en: Mum cooks as soon as she gets home.
items.why: 一 goes right before the first verb 回家 and 就 right before 做饭. The subject 妈妈 is normally said once, before 一, though it may also follow the 一回家 phrase.

items.src: 只要你付钱，他就给你这个东西。
items.src_py: zhǐ yào nǐ fù qián tā jiù gěi nǐ zhè ge dōng xi
items.task: Make payment the only condition: use 只有…才.
items.zh: 只有你付钱，他才给你这个东西。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu nǐ fù qián tā cái gěi nǐ zhè ge dōng xi
items.en: He will give you this thing only if you pay.
items.why: 只有 marks the only condition that works, so its partner is 才 instead of 就, after the second subject 他.

items.src: 这个手机很好用，也很便宜。
items.src_py: zhè ge shǒu jī hěn hǎo yòng yě hěn pián yi
items.task: Join the two points with 不但…而且.
items.zh: 这个手机不但很好用，而且很便宜。
items.py: zhè ge shǒu jī bù dàn hěn hǎo yòng ér qiě hěn pián yi
items.en: This phone is not only easy to use, it is also cheap.
items.why: The subject is shared, so it comes before 不但, and 而且 then introduces the second quality.

items.src: 我去买鞋，没有去买衣服。
items.src_py: wǒ qù mǎi xié méi yǒu qù mǎi yī fu
items.task: Say 'not A but B' with 不是…而是.
items.zh: 我不是去买衣服，而是去买鞋。
items.py: wǒ bù shì qù mǎi yī fu ér shì qù mǎi xié
items.en: I'm not going to buy clothes; I'm going to buy shoes.
items.why: A correction is 不是 A 而是 B. 就是 would claim it is always one of the two.

items.s: 如果东西坏了，就商店给你换新的。
items.s_py: rú guǒ dōng xi huài le jiù shāng diàn gěi nǐ huàn xīn de
items.zh: 如果东西坏了，商店就给你换新的。
items.py: rú guǒ dōng xi huài le shāng diàn jiù gěi nǐ huàn xīn de
items.en: If it is broken, the shop will swap it for a new one.
items.why: 就 is an adverb and must follow the second subject 商店, not stand in front of it.

items.s: 只有你同意，我们就买这台电视。
items.s_py: zhǐ yǒu nǐ tóng yì wǒ men jiù mǎi zhè tái diàn shì
items.zh: 只有你同意，我们才买这台电视。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu nǐ tóng yì wǒ men cái mǎi zhè tái diàn shì
items.en: We'll buy this TV only if you agree.
items.why: 只有 (the only condition) goes with 才. 就 belongs to 只要 and 如果.

items.s: 不管价格很贵，妈妈都要买。
items.s_py: bù guǎn jià gé hěn guì mā ma dōu yào mǎi
items.zh: 不管价格多贵，妈妈都要买。
items.py: bù guǎn jià gé duō guì mā ma dōu yào mǎi
items.en: However expensive the price is, Mum will buy it.
items.why: 不管 needs an open question form such as 多贵. 很贵 is a plain statement and cannot follow it.

items.s: 因为让孩子高兴，爸爸给他买了新玩具。
items.s_py: yīn wèi ràng hái zi gāo xìng bà ba gěi tā mǎi le xīn wán jù
items.zh: 为了让孩子高兴，爸爸给他买了新玩具。
items.py: wèi le ràng hái zi gāo xìng bà ba gěi tā mǎi le xīn wán jù
items.en: To make the child happy, Dad bought him a new toy.
items.why: Making the child happy is the aim of the purchase, so the opener must be 为了. 因为 would need a reason that already exists.

items.s: 就算价格很高，爸爸才要买。
items.s_py: jiù suàn jià gé hěn gāo bà ba cái yào mǎi
items.zh: 就算价格很高，爸爸也要买。
items.py: jiù suàn jià gé hěn gāo bà ba yě yào mǎi
items.en: Even if the price is high, Dad will still buy it.
items.why: 就算 (even if) takes 也 after the second subject. 才 means 'only then', which contradicts 'even if'.

items.s: 这条裤子一边便宜一边好看。
items.s_py: zhè tiáo kù zi yī biān pián yi yī biān hǎo kàn
items.zh: 这条裤子又便宜又好看。
items.py: zhè tiáo kù zi yòu pián yi yòu hǎo kàn
items.en: These trousers are both cheap and nice-looking.
items.why: 一边…一边 joins two actions done at once. Qualities of one thing are joined by 又…又.

items.s: 一妈妈回家，我们就吃饭。
items.s_py: yī mā ma huí jiā wǒ men jiù chī fàn
items.zh: 妈妈一回家，我们就吃饭。
items.py: mā ma yī huí jiā wǒ men jiù chī fàn
items.en: As soon as Mum gets home, we eat.
items.why: 一 must stand right before the first verb, after the subject 妈妈, not at the very start of the clause.

items.s: 超市里的人越来越很多了。
items.s_py: chāo shì lǐ de rén yuè lái yuè hěn duō le
items.zh: 超市里的人越来越多了。
items.py: chāo shì lǐ de rén yuè lái yuè duō le
items.en: There are more and more people in the supermarket.
items.why: 越来越 already expresses degree, so 很 cannot follow it.

items.s: 这不是我的钱包，但是我妹妹的。
items.s_py: zhè bù shì wǒ de qián bāo dàn shì wǒ mèi mei de
items.zh: 这不是我的钱包，而是我妹妹的。
items.py: zhè bù shì wǒ de qián bāo ér shì wǒ mèi mei de
items.en: This is not my wallet but my younger sister's.
items.why: 'Not A but B' is 不是…而是. 但是 follows 虽然 and cannot complete 不是.

items.s: 除了星期一，这家商店每天还开门。
items.s_py: chú le xīng qī yī zhè jiā shāng diàn měi tiān hái kāi mén
items.zh: 除了星期一，这家商店每天都开门。
items.py: chú le xīng qī yī zhè jiā shāng diàn měi tiān dōu kāi mén
items.en: The shop is open every day except Monday.
items.why: Monday is left out, so the partner is 都. 还 means 'besides', which does not fit 每天.

items.s: 只要你喜欢，就我买给你。
items.s_py: zhǐ yào nǐ xǐ huan jiù wǒ mǎi gěi nǐ
items.zh: 只要你喜欢，我就买给你。
items.py: zhǐ yào nǐ xǐ huan wǒ jiù mǎi gěi nǐ
items.en: As long as you like it, I'll buy it for you.
items.why: 就 is an adverb and follows the subject 我. Placed before 我 it is wrong.

items.s: 因为太累了，可是我早睡了。
items.s_py: yīn wèi tài lèi le kě shì wǒ zǎo shuì le
items.zh: 因为太累了，所以我早睡了。
items.py: yīn wèi tài lèi le suǒ yǐ wǒ zǎo shuì le
items.en: Because I was too tired, I went to bed early.
items.why: Being tired is the reason for sleeping early, so the result clause needs 所以. 可是 marks a contrast and cannot answer 因为.

items.s: 因为超市今天打折，所以人特别多。
items.zh: 因为超市今天打折，所以人特别多。
items.py: yīn wèi chāo shì jīn tiān dǎ zhé suǒ yǐ rén tè bié duō
items.en: Because the supermarket has a sale today, there are a lot of people.
items.why: Using both 因为 and 所以 is normal Chinese, unlike English. 所以 sits at the head of the result clause.

items.s: 虽然哥哥已经吃饱了，但是他还是想吃蛋糕。
items.zh: 虽然哥哥已经吃饱了，但是他还是想吃蛋糕。
items.py: suī rán gē ge yǐ jīng chī bǎo le dàn shì tā hái shi xiǎng chī dàn gāo
items.en: Although my brother is already full, he still wants to eat cake.
items.why: 虽然 keeps its partner 但是, even though English drops 'but'. 还是 follows the subject 他.

items.s: 要是价格不太高的话，姐姐就买。
items.zh: 要是价格不太高的话，姐姐就买。
items.py: yào shi jià gé bù tài gāo de huà jiě jie jiù mǎi
items.en: If the price isn't too high, my sister will buy it.
items.why: 要是 and 的话 may frame the if-clause together, and 就 follows the second subject 姐姐.

items.s: 除了周末以外，爸爸每天都加班。
items.zh: 除了周末以外，爸爸每天都加班。
items.py: chú le zhōu mò yǐ wài bà ba měi tiān dōu jiā bān
items.en: Dad works overtime every day except at weekends.
items.why: 'Except' takes 都 after the subject, and 以外 is optional but allowed.

items.s: 不管是大的还是小的，妹妹都喜欢。
items.zh: 不管是大的还是小的，妹妹都喜欢。
items.py: bù guǎn shì dà de hái shi xiǎo de mèi mei dōu xǐ huan
items.en: My younger sister likes them whether big or small.
