items.why: A 还是 choice is a valid open question after 不管, and 都 follows the subject 妹妹.

items.s: 弟弟一回家就要看电视。
items.zh: 弟弟一回家就要看电视。
items.py: dì di yī huí jiā jiù yào kàn diàn shì
items.en: As soon as my little brother gets home, he wants to watch TV.
items.why: Here 一 and 就 share one subject, so the subject appears only once, before 一.

items.s: 孩子们越玩越开心，一直不想回家。
items.zh: 孩子们越玩越开心，一直不想回家。
items.py: hái zi men yuè wán yuè kāi xīn yī zhí bù xiǎng huí jiā
items.en: The more the children play, the happier they get, and they don't want to go home.
items.why: 越 + verb + 越 + adjective is correct when one thing grows with another, and the adjective is bare.

items.s: 要么你来我家，要么我去你家，我们得见一面。
items.zh: 要么你来我家，要么我去你家，我们得见一面。
items.py: yào me nǐ lái wǒ jiā yào me wǒ qù nǐ jiā wǒ men děi jiàn yī miàn
items.en: Either you come to my place or I go to yours; we have to meet.
items.why: 要么…要么 offers two options to choose from, and each 要么 opens its clause before the subject.

items.q: 我嗓子很疼，___今天不想说话。
items.zh: 我嗓子很疼，所以今天不想说话。
items.py: wǒ sǎng zi hěn téng suǒ yǐ jīn tiān bù xiǎng shuō huà
items.en: My throat really hurts, so I don't feel like talking today.
items.why: The first clause is a reason and the second its result, so 所以 comes before the second subject. 但是 would set up a contrast and 如果 a supposition, neither of which fits a plain cause.

items.q: ___保持身体健康，爷爷每天早上都去公园走路。
items.zh: 为了保持身体健康，爷爷每天早上都去公园走路。
items.py: wèi le bǎo chí shēn tǐ jiàn kāng yé ye měi tiān zǎo shang dōu qù gōng yuán zǒu lù
items.en: In order to stay healthy, Grandpa walks in the park every morning.
items.why: Staying healthy is the goal of the walking, not a cause that already happened, so 为了 is needed. 因为 would present it as a reason, and 如果 and 虽然 do not fit at all.

items.q: 既然你发烧了，___在家休息吧，别去上班了。
items.zh: 既然你发烧了，就在家休息吧，别去上班了。
items.py: jì rán nǐ fā shāo le jiù zài jiā xiū xi ba bié qù shàng bān le
items.en: Since you have a fever, rest at home and don't go to work.
items.why: 既然 (since, given that) leads to a suggestion with 就. 才 would mean "only then", and 但是 or 而且 would break the logical link between the fever and the advice.

items.q: 由于昨天晚上下了大雪，___今天学校放假了。
items.zh: 由于昨天晚上下了大雪，因此今天学校放假了。
items.py: yóu yú zuó tiān wǎn shang xià le dà xuě yīn cǐ jīn tiān xué xiào fàng jià le
items.en: Owing to the heavy snow last night, school is closed today.
items.why: 由于 gives the reason and 因此 states the result before the second subject. 虽然, 即使 and 只要 each open their own clause and do not introduce a result.

items.q: ___不感冒，孩子们出门前都要多穿一件衣服。
items.zh: 为了不感冒，孩子们出门前都要多穿一件衣服。
items.py: wèi le bù gǎn mào hái zi men chū mén qián dōu yào duō chuān yī jiàn yī fu
items.en: In order not to catch a cold, the children put on an extra layer before going out.
items.why: Not catching a cold is the aim of putting on more clothes, so 为了 is needed. The other three give a reason or a known fact and make no sense with a wish to avoid a cold.

items.q: ___你已经知道自己对花粉过敏，春天就应该少出门。
items.zh: 既然你已经知道自己对花粉过敏，春天就应该少出门。
items.py: jì rán nǐ yǐ jīng zhī dao zì jǐ duì huā fěn guò mǐn chūn tiān jiù yīng gāi shǎo chū mén
items.en: Since you already know you are allergic to pollen, you should go out less in spring.
items.why: 既然 states a known fact and takes 就 in the next clause. 即使 would need 也 and 虽然 would need 但是, while 只要 would turn the fact into a mere condition.

items.q: ___气温突然下降，___很多人感冒了。
items.zh: 由于气温突然下降，因此很多人感冒了。
items.py: yóu yú qì wēn tū rán xià jiàng yīn cǐ hěn duō rén gǎn mào le
items.en: Because the temperature suddenly dropped, many people caught colds.
items.why: 由于 gives the cause and 因此 the result. 虽然…但是 would contrast the two clauses, 如果…就 would make the cause hypothetical, and 不但…而且 would just add them.

items.q: 虽然今天很冷，___我还是想去游泳。
items.zh: 虽然今天很冷，但是我还是想去游泳。
items.py: suī rán jīn tiān hěn lěng dàn shì wǒ hái shì xiǎng qù yóu yǒng
items.en: Although it is cold today, I still want to go swimming.
items.why: 虽然 states a fact and the second clause needs 但是 even though English drops "but". 所以 and 因为 turn it into cause and effect, which does not fit the cold.

items.q: ___明天天气不好，我们也要去爬山。
items.zh: 即使明天天气不好，我们也要去爬山。
items.py: jí shǐ míng tiān tiān qì bù hǎo wǒ men yě yào qù pá shān
items.en: Even if the weather is bad tomorrow, we are going hiking.
items.why: 明天 is not yet a fact, so the supposed case needs 即使, which pairs with 也. 只要 would make bad weather a sufficient condition for going, and 既然 and 因为 give reasons.

items.q: 他尽管发着高烧，___坚持把工作做完。
items.zh: 他尽管发着高烧，还是坚持把工作做完。
items.py: tā jǐn guǎn fā zhe gāo shāo hái shì jiān chí bǎ gōng zuò zuò wán
items.en: Even though he had a high fever, he still insisted on finishing the work.
items.why: 尽管 states a real fact and the second clause is a contrast marked by 还是 after the subject. 因此 would claim the fever caused the effort, and 只要 and 如果 start a condition.

items.q: ___医生已经一再提醒他少吃盐，他还是每顿饭都吃得很咸。
items.zh: 尽管医生已经一再提醒他少吃盐，他还是每顿饭都吃得很咸。
items.py: jǐn guǎn yī shēng yǐ jīng yī zài tí xǐng tā shǎo chī yán tā hái shì měi dùn fàn dōu chī de hěn xián
items.en: Even though the doctor has reminded him again and again to eat less salt, he still eats very salty food at every meal.
items.why: 已经 marks the reminding as a real fact, so 尽管 fits with 还是. 即使 is for a supposed case, and 因为 and 如果 do not match the contrast.

items.q: 就算明天下雨，我___要去上班。
items.zh: 就算明天下雨，我也要去上班。
items.py: jiù suàn míng tiān xià yǔ wǒ yě yào qù shàng bān
items.en: Even if it rains tomorrow, I still have to go to work.
items.why: 就算 supposes a case and takes 也 after the subject. 但是, 所以 and 因此 are conjunctions that do not belong with 就算.

items.q: ___他的腿还很疼，___他今天坚持来上课了。
items.zh: 虽然他的腿还很疼，但是他今天坚持来上课了。
items.py: suī rán tā de tuǐ hái hěn téng dàn shì tā jīn tiān jiān chí lái shàng kè le
items.en: Although his leg still hurts, he insisted on coming to class today.
items.why: The pain is a real fact and the second clause is a contrast, so 虽然…但是. 即使 would imagine the pain, and 因为…所以 or 如果…就 would turn it into a cause or a condition.

items.q: 他___每天都按时吃药，病却一直没有好。
items.zh: 他虽然每天都按时吃药，病却一直没有好。
items.py: tā suī rán měi tiān dōu àn shí chī yào bìng què yì zhí méi yǒu hǎo
items.en: Although he takes his medicine on time every day, he has not got better.
items.why: 每天都按时吃药 is a real fact and 却 marks the contrast, so 虽然 is right, placed after the subject. 即使 supposes, 只要 sets a condition and 既然 gives a reason.

items.q: ___明天你的感冒好了，医生也要你再休息两天。
items.zh: 即使明天你的感冒好了，医生也要你再休息两天。
items.py: jí shǐ míng tiān nǐ de gǎn mào hǎo le yī shēng yě yào nǐ zài xiū xi liǎng tiān
items.en: Even if your cold is better tomorrow, the doctor still wants you to rest two more days.
items.why: 明天你的感冒好了 has not happened yet, so it is a supposed case: 即使 with 也. 虽然 needs a fact that already holds, and 既然 and 因为 would be reasons.

items.q: 如果你头疼，我们___去医院看看。
items.zh: 如果你头疼，我们就去医院看看。
items.py: rú guǒ nǐ tóu téng wǒ men jiù qù yī yuàn kàn kàn
items.en: If you have a headache, we will go to the hospital and have a look.
items.why: 如果 takes 就 after the second subject. 才 would mean "only then", and 所以 or 但是 are conjunctions that do not match a condition.

items.q: 只有每天睡够八个小时，我___有精神。
items.zh: 只有每天睡够八个小时，我才有精神。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu měi tiān shuì gòu bā gè xiǎo shí wǒ cái yǒu jīng shén
items.en: Only if I sleep a full eight hours every day do I feel energetic.
items.why: 只有 names the one condition that works, so its partner is 才. 就 belongs with 只要 and 如果, and 都 or 还 do not pair with 只有.

items.q: 只要不下雨，我们___去公园玩。
items.zh: 只要不下雨，我们就去公园玩。
items.py: zhǐ yào bù xià yǔ wǒ men jiù qù gōng yuán wán
items.en: As long as it doesn't rain, we'll go to the park to play.
items.why: 只要 means this one condition is enough, so it takes 就. 才 is the partner of 只有, and 但是 and 所以 are conjunctions that cannot sit here.

items.q: 要是你对牛奶过敏的话，早餐___别喝牛奶了。
items.zh: 要是你对牛奶过敏的话，早餐就别喝牛奶了。
items.py: yào shì nǐ duì niú nǎi guò mǐn de huà zǎo cān jiù bié hē niú nǎi le
items.en: If you are allergic to milk, then don't drink milk at breakfast.
items.why: 要是…的话 leads to 就 in the next clause. 才 would change the meaning to "only then", and 所以 and 而是 do not fit a condition.

items.q: 只有医生同意了，他___能出院。
items.zh: 只有医生同意了，他才能出院。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu yī shēng tóng yì le tā cái néng chū yuàn
items.en: Only when the doctor agrees can he leave the hospital.
items.why: 只有 sets the only workable condition and takes 才. 就 is the partner of 只要, and 也 or 还 would add meaning that is not there.

items.q: 只要坚持锻炼，你的身体___会慢慢好起来的。
items.zh: 只要坚持锻炼，你的身体就会慢慢好起来的。
items.py: zhǐ yào jiān chí duàn liàn nǐ de shēn tǐ jiù huì màn màn hǎo qǐ lái de
items.en: As long as you keep exercising, your body will gradually get better.
items.why: 只要 means one thing is enough, so its partner is 就. 才 would make exercise the only way, which contradicts the cue, and 但是 and 虽然 are contrast words.

items.q: ___夏天一直这么热，我们___得装空调了。
items.zh: 如果夏天一直这么热，我们就得装空调了。
items.py: rú guǒ xià tiān yì zhí zhè me rè wǒ men jiù děi zhuāng kōng tiáo le
items.en: If summer stays this hot, we will have to put in an air conditioner.
items.why: 如果…就 sets a condition and its result. 虽然…但是 contrasts facts, 不但…而且 adds a second point, and 即使…也 would mean "we must anyway", which does not follow from the cue.

items.q: 不管天气怎么样，他每天___去跑步。
items.zh: 不管天气怎么样，他每天都去跑步。
items.py: bù guǎn tiān qì zěn me yàng tā měi tiān dōu qù pǎo bù
items.en: Whatever the weather is like, he goes running every day.
items.why: 不管 plus a question form takes 都 after the subject. 才 would mean "only then", and 但是 and 因此 are conjunctions that do not pair with 不管.

items.q: 无论冬天___夏天，奶奶都坚持早起散步。
items.zh: 无论冬天还是夏天，奶奶都坚持早起散步。
items.py: wú lùn dōng tiān hái shì xià tiān nǎi nai dōu jiān chí zǎo qǐ sàn bù
items.en: Whether it is winter or summer, Grandma gets up early for a walk.
items.why: After 无论 the question form here is A 还是 B, which gives the two open possibilities. 而且, 但是 and 所以 cannot link two alternatives.

items.q: 不管你身体好不好，医生___要你定期检查。
items.zh: 不管你身体好不好，医生都要你定期检查。
items.py: bù guǎn nǐ shēn tǐ hǎo bù hǎo yī shēng dōu yào nǐ dìng qī jiǎn chá
items.en: Whether or not you are in good health, the doctor wants you to have regular check-ups.
items.why: 不管 plus the A-not-A question 好不好 takes 都 in the second clause. 就 and 才 do not pair with 不管, and 但是 would contradict the idea.

items.q: 除了星期天，爸爸每天___去医院上班。
items.zh: 除了星期天，爸爸每天都去医院上班。
items.py: chú le xīng qī tiān bà ba měi tiān dōu qù yī yuàn shàng bān
items.en: Dad goes to work at the hospital every day except Sunday.
items.why: Sunday is left out, so 除了 pairs with 都. 还 and 也 would mean "besides Sunday, also", which makes no sense with 每天.

items.q: 除了感冒药，医生___给我开了一些维生素。
items.zh: 除了感冒药，医生还给我开了一些维生素。
items.py: chú le gǎn mào yào yī shēng hái gěi wǒ kāi le yī xiē wéi shēng sù
items.en: Besides the cold medicine, the doctor also prescribed me some vitamins.
items.why: Besides one item and adding another, 除了 pairs with 还. 都 would mean everything except the cold medicine, and 才 and 就 do not fit.

items.q: 除了我，家里人___喜欢吃辣的。
items.zh: 除了我，家里人都喜欢吃辣的。
items.py: chú le wǒ jiā lǐ rén dōu xǐ huan chī là de
items.en: Everyone in my family likes spicy food except me.
items.why: 除了 with 都 means "all but the one named", which fits the cue. 还 would mean "besides me, they also like it", the opposite of the cue.

items.q: 不管天气多么热，他___坚持每天跑五公里。
items.zh: 不管天气多么热，他都坚持每天跑五公里。
items.py: bù guǎn tiān qì duō me rè tā dōu jiān chí měi tiān pǎo wǔ gōng lǐ
items.en: No matter how hot the weather is, he keeps running five kilometres every day.
items.why: 不管 with the question form 多么热 takes 都. 就 and 才 are not the partners of 不管, and 但是 cannot follow 不管.

items.q: 无论医生怎么劝，爷爷___不肯住院。
items.zh: 无论医生怎么劝，爷爷都不肯住院。
items.py: wú lùn yī shēng zěn me quàn yé ye dōu bù kěn zhù yuàn
items.en: No matter how the doctor urges him, Grandpa refuses to go into hospital.
items.why: 无论 plus 怎么 (a question word) takes 都 before the verb. 才 would mean "only then", 越 needs a second 越, and 但是 cannot follow 无论.

items.q: 不管___累，她每天晚上都要锻炼半小时。
items.zh: 不管多累，她每天晚上都要锻炼半小时。
items.py: bù guǎn duō lèi tā měi tiān wǎn shang dōu yào duàn liàn bàn xiǎo shí
items.en: However tired she is, she exercises for half an hour every night.
items.why: 不管 needs a question form, and 多 + adjective ("how tired") is one. 很, 太 and 非常 make a plain statement, which cannot follow 不管.

items.q: 除了每天吃药以外，医生___要求他每周去医院检查一次。
items.zh: 除了每天吃药以外，医生还要求他每周去医院检查一次。
items.py: chú le měi tiān chī yào yǐ wài yī shēng hái yāo qiú tā měi zhōu qù yī yuàn jiǎn chá yī cì
items.en: Besides taking medicine every day, the doctor also requires him to go to the hospital for a check once a week.
items.why: Taking medicine and the weekly check are two things added together, so 以外 is followed by 还. 都 would mean "except", which contradicts the cue.

items.q: 不管是感冒___发烧，他都坚持上班。
items.zh: 不管是感冒还是发烧，他都坚持上班。
items.py: bù guǎn shì gǎn mào hái shì fā shāo tā dōu jiān chí shàng bān
items.en: Whether it is a cold or a fever, he still goes to work.
items.why: 不管 needs two open alternatives, which are joined by 还是. 而是 means "but rather", 而且 means "and moreover" and 所以 means "so", none of which joins alternatives.

items.q: 这个西瓜___大又甜，夏天吃最好了。
items.zh: 这个西瓜又大又甜，夏天吃最好了。
items.py: zhè ge xī guā yòu dà yòu tián xià tiān chī zuì hǎo le
items.en: This watermelon is both big and sweet, perfect to eat in summer.
items.why: Two qualities of one thing are joined by 又…又, so the first slot must also be 又. 也, 还 and 再 cannot start the pair before an adjective.

items.q: 他不但嗓子疼，___还发烧了。
items.zh: 他不但嗓子疼，而且还发烧了。
items.py: tā bù dàn sǎng zi téng ér qiě hái fā shāo le
items.en: Not only does his throat hurt, he also has a fever now.
items.why: 不但 pairs with 而且, which adds a second point and sits before 还. 但是, 所以 and 因为 do not continue an addition.

items.q: 我喜欢一边听音乐，___做运动。
items.zh: 我喜欢一边听音乐，一边做运动。
items.py: wǒ xǐ huan yī biān tīng yīn yuè yī biān zuò yùn dòng
items.en: I like to listen to music while I exercise.
items.why: Two actions at the same time are 一边…一边, so the second slot must be 一边 too. 又 would join qualities, and 越 and 才 do not fit.

items.q: 这种药既苦，___贵，我不想吃。
items.zh: 这种药既苦，又贵，我不想吃。
items.py: zhè zhǒng yào jì kǔ yòu guì wǒ bù xiǎng chī
items.en: This medicine is both bitter and expensive, so I don't want to take it.
items.why: 既 pairs with 又 (or 也) to join two qualities. 就 and 才 are not partners of 既, and 但是 would make the second quality a contrast.

items.q: 不但弟弟爱运动，妹妹___常常陪他去跑步。
items.zh: 不但弟弟爱运动，妹妹也常常陪他去跑步。
items.py: bù dàn dì di ài yùn dòng mèi mei yě cháng cháng péi tā qù pǎo bù
items.en: Not only does my brother love sports, my sister often goes jogging with him too.
items.why: When the two clauses have different subjects, the second clause takes 也 after its subject 妹妹. 才 would mean "only then", and 但是 and 因此 are conjunctions that do not follow 不但 here.

items.q: 雨___下___大，我们只好在山下的小店里等着。
items.zh: 雨越下越大，我们只好在山下的小店里等着。
items.py: yǔ yuè xià yuè dà wǒ men zhǐ hǎo zài shān xià de xiǎo diàn lǐ děng zhe
items.en: The rain was falling harder and harder, so we had no choice but to wait in a little shop at the foot of the hill.
items.why: 越…越 describes one thing growing with another: more rain falling, heavier rain. 又…又 joins qualities, 一边…一边 joins two separate actions, and 不但…而且 adds a point.

items.q: 天气___冷了，大家都穿上了厚衣服。
items.zh: 天气越来越冷了，大家都穿上了厚衣服。
items.py: tiān qì yuè lái yuè lěng le dà jiā dōu chuān shàng le hòu yī fu
items.en: The weather is getting colder and colder, and everybody has put on thick clothes.
items.why: Change over time with an adjective is 越来越. 一边 and 又 and 才 cannot build a "more and more" meaning here.

items.q: 春天来了，白天___来越长了。
items.zh: 春天来了，白天越来越长了。
items.py: chūn tiān lái le bái tiān yuè lái yuè cháng le
items.en: Spring is here and the days are getting longer and longer.
items.why: 越来越 is a fixed unit, so the slot before 来 must be 越. 更 or 又 cannot be followed by 来越 in this pattern.

items.q: 你越着急，病好得___慢。
items.zh: 你越着急，病好得越慢。
items.py: nǐ yuè zháo jí bìng hǎo de yuè màn
items.en: The more anxious you are, the more slowly you get better.
items.why: 越 A 越 B needs a second 越 for the result: the more anxious, the slower. 很 would break the pair, and 就 and 才 do not complete it.

items.q: 冬天过去了，天气___暖和，公园里的人也越来越多了。
items.zh: 冬天过去了，天气越来越暖和，公园里的人也越来越多了。
items.py: dōng tiān guò qù le tiān qì yuè lái yuè nuǎn huo gōng yuán lǐ de rén yě yuè lái yuè duō le
items.en: Winter is over, the weather is getting warmer and warmer, and there are more and more people in the park.
items.why: The sentence describes a change over time with an adjective, so 越来越 is needed. A bare 越 needs a second 越, and 更 and 最 do not show gradual change.

items.q: 这种药你吃得越多，对身体___不好。
items.zh: 这种药你吃得越多，对身体越不好。
items.py: zhè zhǒng yào nǐ chī de yuè duō duì shēn tǐ yuè bù hǎo
items.en: The more of this medicine you take, the worse it is for your body.
items.why: 吃得越多 starts the pair, so the result also needs 越. 很 would leave 越 without its partner, and 就 and 才 are not in this pattern.

items.q: 我不是感冒了，___是过敏了。
items.zh: 我不是感冒了，而是过敏了。
items.py: wǒ bú shì gǎn mào le ér shì guò mǐn le
items.en: It is not that I have a cold; I have an allergy.
items.why: The first part is denied and then corrected, so the pair is 不是…而是. 就是 would say it is always one of the two, which does not match a correction.

items.q: 他最近不是咳嗽，___是发烧，一直没好。
items.zh: 他最近不是咳嗽，就是发烧，一直没好。
items.py: tā zuì jìn bú shì ké sou jiù shì fā shāo yì zhí méi hǎo
items.en: Lately he is always either coughing or running a fever and has not got better.
items.why: The cue says he keeps having one or the other, which is 不是…就是. 而是 would mean "not A but B", a single correction.

items.q: 周末你自己选：___去爬山，___在家休息。
items.zh: 周末你自己选：要么去爬山，要么在家休息。
items.py: zhōu mò nǐ zì jǐ xuǎn ： yào me qù pá shān yào me zài jiā xiū xi
items.en: Choose for yourself this weekend: either go hiking or rest at home.
items.why: "You choose" offers alternatives to pick from, so 要么…要么. 不是…就是 describes what always happens, 不但…而且 adds, and 因为…所以 states a cause.

items.q: 他周末不是看电视，___是睡觉，哪儿也不去。
items.zh: 他周末不是看电视，就是睡觉，哪儿也不去。
items.py: tā zhōu mò bú shì kàn diàn shì jiù shì shuì jiào nǎ r yě bù qù
items.en: At weekends he is either watching TV or sleeping and goes nowhere.
items.why: The cue says it is always one of the two, which is 不是…就是. 而是 would deny watching TV and replace it with sleeping on one occasion.

items.q: 你想怎么治？___吃药，___打针，你自己决定。
items.zh: 你想怎么治？要么吃药，要么打针，你自己决定。
items.py: nǐ xiǎng zěn me zhì yào me chī yào yào me dǎ zhēn nǐ zì jǐ jué dìng
items.en: How do you want to be treated? Either take medicine or have an injection; it is up to you.
items.why: Two options for the listener to choose between are 要么…要么. 不是…就是 would describe a habit, and 既…又 would mean doing both.

items.q: 我一回到家，___觉得头疼。
items.zh: 我一回到家，就觉得头疼。
items.py: wǒ yī huí dào jiā jiù jué de tóu téng
items.en: As soon as I got home, I felt a headache coming on.
items.why: 一 + verb takes 就 for the second event right after. 才 would mean "only then", and 还 or 再 do not express "immediately".

items.q: 我们先去医院看医生，___去药店买药。
items.zh: 我们先去医院看医生，然后去药店买药。
items.py: wǒ men xiān qù yī yuàn kàn yī shēng rán hòu qù yào diàn mǎi yào
items.en: We'll first go to the hospital to see a doctor, and then go to the pharmacy to buy the medicine.
items.why: 先 starts the sequence and 然后 begins the next step. 因此 would claim a cause, 但是 a contrast, and 越 needs a second 越.

items.q: 一到秋天，北京的天气___变得干燥起来。
items.zh: 一到秋天，北京的天气就变得干燥起来。
items.py: yī dào qiū tiān běi jīng de tiān qì jiù biàn de gān zào qǐ lái
items.en: As soon as autumn arrives, the weather in Beijing starts to turn dry.
items.why: 一 + verb is completed by 就 after the second subject. 才 would say "not until", 越 needs a second 越, and 但是 is a contrast word.

items.q: 你___把手洗干净，再给孩子喂药。
items.zh: 你先把手洗干净，再给孩子喂药。
items.py: nǐ xiān bǎ shǒu xǐ gān jìng zài gěi hái zi wèi yào
items.en: First wash your hands clean, then give the child the medicine.
items.why: 再 marks step two, so step one needs 先. 就 or 才 do not set up an order of steps, and 越 needs a second 越.

items.zh: 我一回家就想睡觉。
items.py: wǒ yī huí jiā jiù xiǎng shuì jiào
items.en: As soon as I get home I want to sleep.
items.why: 一 stays right before the first verb and 就 follows the second subject. 就 cannot open the clause before 我.

items.zh: 如果你头疼，我就陪你去医院。
items.py: rú guǒ nǐ tóu téng wǒ jiù péi nǐ qù yī yuàn
items.en: If you have a headache, I will go to the hospital with you.
items.why: The if-clause comes first and 就 follows the second subject 我. Putting 就 before 我 is the classic error.

items.zh: 虽然外面下着大雪，但是他还是去跑步了。
items.py: suī rán wài miàn xià zhe dà xuě dàn shì tā hái shì qù pǎo bù le
items.en: Although it is snowing hard outside, he still went running.
items.why: 虽然 opens the fact and 但是 comes before the subject 他, while 还是 is an adverb that follows 他.

items.zh: 只有多喝水，病才会好得快。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu duō hē shuǐ bìng cái huì hǎo de kuài
items.en: Only if you drink lots of water will the illness get better quickly.
items.why: 只有 names the one condition and its partner 才 follows the second subject 病, not the opener.

items.zh: 不管多冷，奶奶都要出去散步。
items.py: bù guǎn duō lěng nǎi nai dōu yào chū qù sàn bù
items.en: However cold it is, Grandma goes out for a walk.
items.why: 不管 takes a question form (多冷) and 都 follows the subject of the main clause, directly before the verb phrase.

items.zh: 除了发烧，他还觉得喉咙很疼。
items.py: chú le fā shāo tā hái jué de hóu long hěn téng
items.en: Besides having a fever, he also feels that his throat hurts a lot.
items.why: 除了 A with 还 adds a second item, and 还 sits after the subject 他, directly before 觉得.

items.zh: 她一边咳嗽，一边做饭。
items.py: tā yī biān ké sou yī biān zuò fàn
items.en: She is coughing while cooking.
items.why: Two simultaneous actions are 一边 + verb, 一边 + verb, after the shared subject 她.

items.zh: 既然天气这么好，我们就去公园走走吧。
items.py: jì rán tiān qì zhè me hǎo wǒ men jiù qù gōng yuán zǒu zǒu ba
items.en: Since the weather is so nice, let's go for a walk in the park.
items.why: 既然 states the known fact and 就 follows the subject 我们 in the suggestion. 就 cannot come before 我们.

items.zh: 即使明天下大雪，我们也不会取消比赛。
items.py: jí shǐ míng tiān xià dà xuě wǒ men yě bú huì qǔ xiāo bǐ sài
items.en: Even if it snows heavily tomorrow, we will not cancel the match.
items.why: 即使 supposes a case and its partner 也 comes after the subject 我们. The subject may also stand before 即使. 但是 is not used.

items.zh: 我先洗澡，然后睡觉。
items.py: wǒ xiān xǐ zǎo rán hòu shuì jiào
items.en: I'll take a shower first and then go to sleep.
items.why: 先 stands after the subject and before the first verb, and 然后 begins the next step.

items.zh: 这家医院不但医生好，而且环境也很干净。
items.py: zhè jiā yī yuàn bù dàn yī shēng hǎo ér qiě huán jìng yě hěn gān jìng
items.en: This hospital has not only good doctors, but a very clean environment too.
items.why: 不但 and 而且 pair up; the subject can stand before or after 不但 because both clauses are about the same hospital.

items.zh: 这个月不是下雨，就是刮风。
items.py: zhè ge yuè bú shì xià yǔ jiù shì guā fēng
items.en: This month it is either raining or windy.
items.why: 不是 A 就是 B says that it is always one of the two. 这个月 stays at the front.

items.zh: 我不是不想去医院，而是今天实在没有时间。
items.py: wǒ bú shì bù xiǎng qù yī yuàn ér shì jīn tiān shí zài méi yǒu shí jiān
items.en: It is not that I don't want to go to the hospital; I just really have no time today.
items.why: 不是 denies the first idea and 而是 introduces the correct explanation after it.

items.zh: 如果下雪，我就在家看书。
items.py: rú guǒ xià xuě wǒ jiù zài jiā kàn shū
items.en: If it snows, I will read at home.
items.why: 如果 opens the first clause, and 就 stays directly in front of the verb phrase after the second subject 我.

items.zh: 他一吃辣的就流鼻涕。
items.py: tā yī chī là de jiù liú bí tì
items.en: Whenever he eats spicy food his nose runs.
items.why: 一 + verb then 就: the second action follows right away. 就 stays right before the second verb.

items.zh: 尽管医生反复提醒，他还是没有戒烟。
items.py: jǐn guǎn yī shēng fǎn fù tí xǐng tā hái shì méi yǒu jiè yān
items.en: Even though the doctor reminded him again and again, he still did not give up smoking.
items.why: 尽管 states a real fact and its usual partner 还是 sits after the subject 他.

items.zh: 只要每天锻炼，你就会越来越健康。
items.py: zhǐ yào měi tiān duàn liàn nǐ jiù huì yuè lái yuè jiàn kāng
items.en: As long as you exercise every day, you will get healthier and healthier.
items.why: 只要 gives the sufficient condition and 就 follows the clause. The subject 你 may stand before 只要 or right after it, but 就 must come before 会越来越健康.

items.zh: 无论冬天还是夏天，他都坚持洗冷水澡。
items.py: wú lùn dōng tiān hái shì xià tiān tā dōu jiān chí xǐ lěng shuǐ zǎo
items.en: Whether in winter or in summer, he keeps taking cold showers.
items.why: 无论 plus A 还是 B takes 都 after the subject 他, directly before the verb.

items.zh: 雨越下越大。
items.py: yǔ yuè xià yuè dà
items.en: The rain is getting heavier and heavier.
items.why: 越 + verb + 越 + adjective: the rain falls and the more it falls, the heavier it gets.

items.src: 他很累，他还是去上班了。
items.src_py: tā hěn lèi tā hái shì qù shàng bān le
items.task: Join the two clauses with 虽然…但是.
items.zh: 他虽然很累，但是还是去上班了。
items.py: tā suī rán hěn lèi dàn shì hái shì qù shàng bān le
items.en: Although he is tired, he still went to work.
items.why: 虽然 opens the fact (before or after 他) and 但是 comes before 还是, which follows the subject.

items.src: 我喝了热水，觉得舒服多了。
items.src_py: wǒ hē le rè shuǐ jué de shū fu duō le
items.zh: 我一喝热水就觉得舒服多了。
items.py: wǒ yī hē rè shuǐ jiù jué de shū fu duō le
items.en: As soon as I drink hot water I feel much better.
items.why: 一 goes right before the first verb and 就 right before the second, both after the subject 我.

items.src: 不下雨的话，我们就去爬山。
items.src_py: bù xià yǔ de huà wǒ men jiù qù pá shān
items.zh: 只要不下雨，我们就去爬山。
items.py: zhǐ yào bù xià yǔ wǒ men jiù qù pá shān
items.en: As long as it doesn't rain, we'll go hiking.
items.why: 只要 opens the sufficient condition and 就 follows the second subject 我们.

items.src: 他喜欢游泳，也喜欢打篮球。
items.src_py: tā xǐ huan yóu yǒng yě xǐ huan dǎ lán qiú
items.task: Rewrite with 除了…以外 and 还.
items.zh: 除了游泳以外，他还喜欢打篮球。
items.py: chú le yóu yǒng yǐ wài tā hái xǐ huan dǎ lán qiú
items.en: Besides swimming, he also likes playing basketball.
items.why: 除了…以外 with 还 adds an item, and 还 sits after the subject 他.

items.s: 如果你头疼，就我们去医院吧。
items.zh: 如果你头疼，我们就去医院吧。
items.s_py: rú guǒ nǐ tóu téng jiù wǒ men qù yī yuàn ba
items.py: rú guǒ nǐ tóu téng wǒ men jiù qù yī yuàn ba
items.en: If you have a headache, let's go to the hospital.
items.why: 就 is an adverb and must follow the second subject 我们. Putting it in front of 我们 is the classic error.

items.s: 不管天气冷不冷，他才去游泳。
items.zh: 不管天气冷不冷，他都去游泳。
items.s_py: bù guǎn tiān qì lěng bù lěng tā cái qù yóu yǒng
items.py: bù guǎn tiān qì lěng bù lěng tā dōu qù yóu yǒng
items.en: Whether the weather is cold or not, he goes swimming.
items.why: 不管 takes 都 after the subject. 才 would mean 'only then', which contradicts the idea that the weather makes no difference.

items.s: 我的咳嗽越来越非常严重了。
items.zh: 我的咳嗽越来越严重了。
items.s_py: wǒ de ké sou yuè lái yuè fēi cháng yán zhòng le
items.py: wǒ de ké sou yuè lái yuè yán zhòng le
items.en: My cough is getting more and more serious.
items.why: 越来越 already expresses degree, so 非常 cannot follow it.

items.s: 因为变得更健康，他每天都去游泳。
items.zh: 为了变得更健康，他每天都去游泳。
items.s_py: yīn wèi biàn de gèng jiàn kāng tā měi tiān dōu qù yóu yǒng
items.py: wèi le biàn de gèng jiàn kāng tā měi tiān dōu qù yóu yǒng
items.en: He swims every day in order to become healthier.
items.why: Becoming healthier is the aim of the swimming, not a cause, so it needs 为了. 因为 would mean it already happened.

items.s: 除了星期天，医生每天还在医院。
items.zh: 除了星期天，医生每天都在医院。
items.s_py: chú le xīng qī tiān yī shēng měi tiān hái zài yī yuàn
items.py: chú le xīng qī tiān yī shēng měi tiān dōu zài yī yuàn
items.en: The doctor is at the hospital every day except Sunday.
items.why: Sunday is the exception, so the partner is 都. 还 would mean "besides Sunday", which does not fit 每天.

items.s: 即使明天会下雪，所以我们也要去爬山。
items.zh: 即使明天会下雪，我们也要去爬山。
items.s_py: jí shǐ míng tiān huì xià xuě suǒ yǐ wǒ men yě yào qù pá shān
items.py: jí shǐ míng tiān huì xià xuě wǒ men yě yào qù pá shān
items.en: Even if it snows tomorrow, we are still going hiking.
items.why: 即使 supposes a case and goes straight to 也 after the subject. 所以 turns the supposed case into a reason, which cannot follow 即使.

items.s: 你可以选择：要么去看医生，不是在家休息。
items.zh: 你可以选择：要么去看医生，要么在家休息。
items.s_py: nǐ kě yǐ xuǎn zé ： yào me qù kàn yī shēng bú shì zài jiā xiū xi
items.py: nǐ kě yǐ xuǎn zé ： yào me qù kàn yī shēng yào me zài jiā xiū xi
items.en: You can choose: either see a doctor or rest at home.
items.why: 要么 pairs with 要么 to offer alternatives. 不是 does not complete it.

items.s: 只要你不吃甜的，才能控制体重。
items.zh: 只要你不吃甜的，就能控制体重。
items.s_py: zhǐ yào nǐ bù chī tián de cái néng kòng zhì tǐ zhòng
items.py: zhǐ yào nǐ bù chī tián de jiù néng kòng zhì tǐ zhòng
items.en: As long as you avoid sweet food, you can control your weight.
items.why: 只要 means this one condition is enough and takes 就. 才 belongs with 只有.

items.s: 一他吃辣的就咳嗽。
items.zh: 他一吃辣的就咳嗽。
items.s_py: yī tā chī là de jiù ké sou
items.py: tā yī chī là de jiù ké sou
items.en: He coughs as soon as he eats anything spicy.
items.why: 一 goes after the subject, right before the first verb. It cannot stand before 他.

items.s: 这个季节的早上一边冷一边湿。
items.zh: 这个季节的早上又冷又湿。
items.s_py: zhè ge jì jié de zǎo shang yī biān lěng yī biān shī
items.py: zhè ge jì jié de zǎo shang yòu lěng yòu shī
items.en: In this season the mornings are both cold and damp.
items.why: Two qualities are joined by 又…又. 一边…一边 is only for two actions happening at the same time, not for adjectives.

items.s: 要是明天不下雪的话，我们就去滑冰。
items.zh: 要是明天不下雪的话，我们就去滑冰。
items.py: yào shì míng tiān bù xià xuě de huà wǒ men jiù qù huá bīng
items.en: If it doesn't snow tomorrow, we'll go ice skating.
items.why: 要是…的话 with 就 after 我们 is right. 的话 is optional and does not change the partner.

items.s: 虽然他感冒了，但是他没有请假。
items.zh: 虽然他感冒了，但是他没有请假。
items.py: suī rán tā gǎn mào le dàn shì tā méi yǒu qǐng jià
items.en: Although he caught a cold, he did not take sick leave.
items.why: 虽然 and 但是 both appear, which is correct. English drops "but", Chinese keeps it.

items.s: 除了小李，我们都去医院检查了。
items.zh: 除了小李，我们都去医院检查了。
items.py: chú le xiǎo lǐ wǒ men dōu qù yī yuàn jiǎn chá le
items.en: Everyone but Xiao Li went to the hospital for a check-up.
items.why: 除了 with 都 means "all but", with 我们 as the subject right before 都.

items.s: 不管明天下不下雨，我们都出发。
items.zh: 不管明天下不下雨，我们都出发。
items.py: bù guǎn míng tiān xià bù xià yǔ wǒ men dōu chū fā
items.en: Whether or not it rains tomorrow, we set off.
items.why: The A-not-A question 下不下雨 follows 不管, and 都 comes after 我们. This is the standard pattern.

items.s: 既然已经发烧了，你就别出去了。
items.zh: 既然已经发烧了，你就别出去了。
items.py: jì rán yǐ jīng fā shāo le nǐ jiù bié chū qù le
items.en: Since you already have a fever, don't go out.
items.why: 既然 takes 就, which follows the second subject 你. 所以 is not needed.

items.s: 天气越来越暖和，花也越开越多。
items.zh: 天气越来越暖和，花也越开越多。
items.py: tiān qì yuè lái yuè nuǎn huo huā yě yuè kāi yuè duō
items.en: The weather is getting warmer and warmer and more and more flowers are coming out.
items.why: 越来越 goes with an adjective, and 越开越多 is the 越-verb-越-adjective pattern. Both are correct side by side.

items.s: 你只有多休息，才会好起来。
items.zh: 你只有多休息，才会好起来。
items.py: nǐ zhǐ yǒu duō xiū xi cái huì hǎo qǐ lái
items.en: Only if you rest a lot will you get better.
items.why: 只有 takes 才, and the subject 你 may stand before 只有.

items.s: 他一边洗澡，一边唱歌。
items.zh: 他一边洗澡，一边唱歌。
items.py: tā yī biān xǐ zǎo yī biān chàng gē
items.en: He sings while taking a shower.
items.why: 洗澡 and 唱歌 are two actions at the same time, so 一边…一边 is correct.

items.s: 我不但感冒了，而且还发烧了。
items.zh: 我不但感冒了，而且还发烧了。
items.py: wǒ bù dàn gǎn mào le ér qiě hái fā shāo le
items.en: Not only do I have a cold, I also have a fever now.
items.why: 而且还 together is common: 而且 is the conjunction and 还 an adverb.

items.s: 就算你不喜欢苦药，你也得吃。
items.zh: 就算你不喜欢苦药，你也得吃。
items.py: jiù suàn nǐ bù xǐ huan kǔ yào nǐ yě děi chī
items.en: Even if you don't like bitter medicine, you have to take it.
items.why: 就算 pairs with 也 after the second subject 你. 但是 is not needed.

items.q: 只要多喝热水，感冒___会好的。
items.zh: 只要多喝热水，感冒就会好的。
items.py: zhǐ yào duō hē rè shuǐ gǎn mào jiù huì hǎo de
items.en: As long as you drink plenty of hot water, your cold will get better.
items.why: 只要 means this one condition is enough, so 就 follows the subject 感冒. 才 would make hot water the only cure, and 但是 and 所以 are conjunctions that do not belong here.

items.q: 天气一热，他___想吃冰淇淋。
items.zh: 天气一热，他就想吃冰淇淋。
items.py: tiān qì yī rè tā jiù xiǎng chī bīng qí lín
items.en: As soon as the weather turns hot, he wants to eat ice cream.
items.why: 一 + verb is completed by 就 after the second subject. 才 would say "not until", 再 means "again/then", and 越 needs a second 越.

items.s: 因为能赶上比赛，他六点就出门了。
items.s_py: yīn wèi néng gǎn shàng bǐ sài tā liù diǎn jiù chū mén le
items.zh: 为了能赶上比赛，他六点就出门了。
items.py: wèi le néng gǎn shàng bǐ sài tā liù diǎn jiù chū mén le
items.en: In order to be able to catch the match, he left home at six.
items.why: Catching the match is the goal that makes him leave early, not a cause. A goal takes 为了.

items.q: 如果你在路上迷路的话，你___给我打电话，我去接你。
items.zh: 如果你在路上迷路的话，你就给我打电话，我去接你。
items.py: rú guǒ nǐ zài lù shang mí lù de huà nǐ jiù gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà wǒ qù jiē nǐ
items.en: If you get lost on the way, just call me and I'll come and pick you up.
items.why: 如果…(的话) takes 就 after the second subject 你. 才 would make calling the only thing allowed, and 而且 adds information.

items.zh: 除了足球，他还喜欢打篮球和游泳。
items.py: chú le zú qiú tā hái xǐ huan dǎ lán qiú hé yóu yǒng
items.en: Besides football, he also likes basketball and swimming.
items.why: 还 adds to the 除了 item and stands after the subject 他, before 喜欢.

items.q: 只要你按时到，教练___让你上场。
items.zh: 只要你按时到，教练就让你上场。
items.py: zhǐ yào nǐ àn shí dào jiào liàn jiù ràng nǐ shàng chǎng
items.en: As long as you arrive on time, the coach will let you play.
items.why: 只要 means one easy condition is enough, so 就. 才 would turn it into 'only then', which is 只有.

items.zh: 这家面馆又便宜又干净。
items.py: zhè jiā miàn guǎn yòu pián yi yòu gān jìng
items.en: This noodle shop is both cheap and clean.
items.why: 又 comes before each quality, and no 很 sits inside the pattern. The two qualities can swap places.

items.src: 晴天他去公园跑步，下雨天他也去。
items.src_py: qíng tiān tā qù gōng yuán pǎo bù xià yǔ tiān tā yě qù
items.zh: 不管晴天还是雨天，他都去公园跑步。
items.py: bù guǎn qíng tiān hái shi yǔ tiān tā dōu qù gōng yuán pǎo bù
items.en: Rain or shine, he goes running in the park.
items.why: 不管 takes the choice question 晴天还是雨天, and 都 follows the subject 他.

items.src: 他回到家，马上给妈妈打电话。
items.src_py: tā huí dào jiā mǎ shàng gěi mā ma dǎ diàn huà
items.zh: 他一回到家就给妈妈打电话。
items.py: tā yī huí dào jiā jiù gěi mā ma dǎ diàn huà
items.en: As soon as he gets home he calls his mum.
items.why: 一 goes right before the first verb and 就 before the second. The subject can stand before 一 or after the 一-clause, but 一 never moves away from its verb.

items.q: 这家球馆不但便宜，___离地铁站很近。
items.zh: 这家球馆不但便宜，还离地铁站很近。
items.py: zhè jiā qiú guǎn bù dàn pián yi hái lí dì tiě zhàn hěn jìn
items.en: This gym is not only cheap, it is also close to the subway station.
items.why: 不但 takes 而且, 还 or 也 after it. 就 and 才 are partners of 如果 and 只有.

items.src: 最近来体育馆的人变多了。
items.src_py: zuì jìn lái tǐ yù guǎn de rén biàn duō le
items.task: Say there are more and more of them.
items.zh: 最近来体育馆的人越来越多了。
items.py: zuì jìn lái tǐ yù guǎn de rén yuè lái yuè duō le
items.en: More and more people have been coming to the gym lately.
items.why: 越来越 replaces 变 and sits directly before the adjective 多.

items.zh: 你先往前走，然后在第二个路口往右转。
items.py: nǐ xiān wǎng qián zǒu rán hòu zài dì èr gè lù kǒu wǎng yòu zhuǎn
items.en: Go straight first, then turn right at the second intersection.
items.why: 先 marks step one, 然后 the next step. The place phrase stays before the verb 往右转.

items.q: 他一看地图___明白了该怎么走。
items.zh: 他一看地图就明白了该怎么走。
items.py: tā yī kàn dì tú jiù míng bai le gāi zěn me zǒu
items.en: The moment he looked at the map, he understood which way to go.
items.why: 一…就 means 'the moment one does the first thing, the second follows'. 才 cannot be paired with 一.

items.q: 因为公交车坏了，___我们走路去体育馆。
items.zh: 因为公交车坏了，所以我们走路去体育馆。
items.py: yīn wèi gōng jiāo chē huài le suǒ yǐ wǒ men zǒu lù qù tǐ yù guǎn
items.en: Because the bus broke down, we walked to the gym.
items.why: 因为 is answered by 所以 before the result. 但是 would signal a contrast and 而且 an addition.

items.q: 尽管天气很热，他们___在操场上踢球。
items.zh: 尽管天气很热，他们还是在操场上踢球。
items.py: jǐn guǎn tiān qì hěn rè tā men hái shi zài cāo chǎng shàng tī qiú
items.en: Even though it was hot, they still played football on the field.
items.why: 尽管 states a fact, and the result goes against it: 还是 'still'. 因此 and 而且 do not express contrast.

items.zh: 只要你想去，我们就一起去。
items.py: zhǐ yào nǐ xiǎng qù wǒ men jiù yī qǐ qù
items.en: As long as you want to go, we'll go together.
items.why: 就 follows the second subject 我们 and comes before 一起去; it cannot come before 我们.

items.q: 除了这家店以外，附近的商店___关门了，所以我只能来这里买运动鞋。
items.zh: 除了这家店以外，附近的商店都关门了，所以我只能来这里买运动鞋。
items.py: chú le zhè jiā diàn yǐ wài fù jìn de shāng diàn dōu guān mén le suǒ yǐ wǒ zhǐ néng lái zhè lǐ mǎi yùn dòng xié
items.en: Except for this shop, all the shops nearby are closed, so I can only buy sports shoes here.
items.why: This shop is the exception and all the others are closed: 都. 还 would add to it, contradicting 只能来这里.

items.zh: 他不是在跑步，而是在散步。
items.py: tā bù shì zài pǎo bù ér shì zài sàn bù
items.en: He isn't running; he's taking a stroll.
items.why: 不是 A 而是 B puts the denied option first and the correct one after 而是.

items.zh: 为了赶上末班地铁，他们跑着去了车站。
items.py: wèi le gǎn shàng mò bān dì tiě tā men pǎo zhe qù le chē zhàn
items.en: To catch the last subway, they ran to the station.
items.why: 为了 opens the goal clause. The goal comes before the action it explains.

items.zh: 他一下场就去喝水。
items.py: tā yī xià chǎng jiù qù hē shuǐ
items.en: As soon as he leaves the court, he goes to drink some water.
items.why: 一 stands directly before the first verb 下场 and 就 before the second. The subject 他 may come before 一 or after 一下场, but not between 一 and 下场.

items.q: 只有每天练习，你___能游得更快。
items.zh: 只有每天练习，你才能游得更快。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu měi tiān liàn xí nǐ cái néng yóu de gèng kuài
items.en: Only by practising every day can you swim faster.
items.why: 只有 names the only condition that works and takes 才. 就 goes with 只要.

items.zh: 我们先去地铁站，再去体育馆。
items.py: wǒ men xiān qù dì tiě zhàn zài qù tǐ yù guǎn
items.en: We'll go to the subway station first, then to the gym.
items.why: 先 stands before the first step and 再 before the second, both directly in front of their verbs.

items.q: 只有天气好，我们___去爬山。
items.zh: 只有天气好，我们才去爬山。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu tiān qì hǎo wǒ men cái qù pá shān
items.en: We'll go hiking only if the weather is good.
items.why: 只有 names the one condition that works, so its partner is 才. 就 belongs with 只要 and 如果.

items.s: 不管你喜不喜欢，他都要去体育馆。
items.s_py: bù guǎn nǐ xǐ bu xǐ huan tā dōu yào qù tǐ yù guǎn
items.zh: 不管你喜不喜欢，他都要去体育馆。
items.py: bù guǎn nǐ xǐ bu xǐ huan tā dōu yào qù tǐ yù guǎn
items.en: Whether you like it or not, he's going to the gym.
items.why: This is correct: 不管 has the verb-not-verb question 喜不喜欢, and 都 follows the subject 他.

items.s: 他下班以后不是去健身房，就是去公园跑步。
items.s_py: tā xià bān yǐ hòu bù shì qù jiàn shēn fáng jiù shì qù gōng yuán pǎo bù
items.zh: 他下班以后不是去健身房，就是去公园跑步。
items.py: tā xià bān yǐ hòu bù shì qù jiàn shēn fáng jiù shì qù gōng yuán pǎo bù
items.en: After work he either goes to the gym or goes running in the park.
items.why: This is correct: 不是 A 就是 B says it is always one of the two.

items.zh: 只有多练习，你才能打好网球。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu duō liàn xí nǐ cái néng dǎ hǎo wǎng qiú
items.en: Only by practising a lot can you play tennis well.
items.why: 才 follows the subject 你 and stands before the modal 能. It cannot come before 你.

items.q: ___昨天输了比赛，但是大家一点儿也不难过。
items.zh: 虽然昨天输了比赛，但是大家一点儿也不难过。
items.py: suī rán zuó tiān shū le bǐ sài dàn shì dà jiā yī diǎn r yě bù nán guò
items.en: Although we lost the match yesterday, nobody is sad at all.
items.why: Losing yesterday is a real fact, so 虽然 with 但是. 即使 would treat it as a mere supposition.

items.zh: 不管路有多远，他每天都骑车去上班。
items.py: bù guǎn lù yǒu duō yuǎn tā měi tiān dōu qí chē qù shàng bān
items.en: However far the road is, he cycles to work every day.
items.why: 都 comes after the subject and 每天 and before the verb phrase.

items.q: 他不是去跑步，___去爬山。
items.zh: 他不是去跑步，而是去爬山。
items.py: tā bù shì qù pǎo bù ér shì qù pá shān
items.en: He isn't going running; he's going hiking.
items.why: The cue corrects one fact with another: 不是 A 而是 B. 就是 would make it 'either A or B', and 但是 does not pair with 不是.

items.q: 我一到公园___看见很多人在打球。
items.zh: 我一到公园就看见很多人在打球。
items.py: wǒ yī dào gōng yuán jiù kàn jiàn hěn duō rén zài dǎ qiú
items.en: As soon as I got to the park, I saw lots of people playing ball.
items.why: 一…就 means 'as soon as': 就 follows right behind the first action. 才 would say it happened late.

items.zh: 他周末不是踢球，就是游泳。
items.py: tā zhōu mò bù shì tī qiú jiù shì yóu yǒng
items.en: At weekends he either plays football or goes swimming.
items.why: 不是 A 就是 B: the two parts come in this order, and 就是 starts the second option.

items.q: ___我喜欢游泳，所以每个周末都去游泳馆。
items.zh: 因为我喜欢游泳，所以每个周末都去游泳馆。
items.py: yīn wèi wǒ xǐ huan yóu yǒng suǒ yǐ měi gè zhōu mò dōu qù yóu yǒng guǎn
items.en: Because I like swimming, I go to the swimming pool every weekend.
items.why: 所以 introduces a result, so the first clause must give the reason: 因为. 虽然 and 如果 do not pair with 所以.

items.s: 他一边骑车，一边听音乐，非常危险。
items.s_py: tā yī biān qí chē yī biān tīng yīn yuè fēi cháng wēi xiǎn
items.zh: 他一边骑车，一边听音乐，非常危险。
items.py: tā yī biān qí chē yī biān tīng yīn yuè fēi cháng wēi xiǎn
items.en: He listens to music while riding, which is very dangerous.
items.why: This is correct: 一边…一边 joins two simultaneous actions, and 很/非常 appears only in a separate clause.

items.q: 虽然今天很冷，___我还是去跑步了。
items.zh: 虽然今天很冷，但是我还是去跑步了。
items.py: suī rán jīn tiān hěn lěng dàn shì wǒ hái shi qù pǎo bù le
items.en: Although it is cold today, I still went running.
items.why: 虽然 states a fact and the second clause turns against it with 但是. 所以 and 因为 would claim the cold caused or explains the run.

items.q: 即使这家餐厅离体育馆很远，我们___会去，因为那里的面条非常好吃。
items.zh: 即使这家餐厅离体育馆很远，我们也会去，因为那里的面条非常好吃。
items.py: jí shǐ zhè jiā cān tīng lí tǐ yù guǎn hěn yuǎn wǒ men yě huì qù yīn wèi nà lǐ de miàn tiáo fēi cháng hǎo chī
items.en: Even if this restaurant is far from the stadium, we'll go, because the noodles there are very good.
items.why: 即使 supposes a case and takes 也 after the subject. 但是 belongs with 虽然.

items.q: 虽然他才十岁，___他游得比大人还快。
items.zh: 虽然他才十岁，但是他游得比大人还快。
items.py: suī rán tā cái shí suì dàn shì tā yóu de bǐ dà rén hái kuài
items.en: Although he is only ten, he swims faster than adults.
items.why: 虽然 sets up a surprising contrast, and 但是 comes before the second subject. 而且 and 所以 do not mark a contrast.

items.zh: 虽然比赛很难，但是我们赢了。
items.py: suī rán bǐ sài hěn nán dàn shì wǒ men yíng le
items.en: Although the match was hard, we won.
items.why: 但是 is a conjunction and stands before the second subject 我们, not after it.

items.s: 他的篮球打得越来越很好了。
items.s_py: tā de lán qiú dǎ de yuè lái yuè hěn hǎo le
items.zh: 他的篮球打得越来越好了。
items.py: tā de lán qiú dǎ de yuè lái yuè hǎo le
items.en: His basketball is getting better and better.
items.why: 越来越 already expresses degree, so 很 cannot follow it.

items.s: 这家店的面一边便宜一边好吃。
items.s_py: zhè jiā diàn de miàn yī biān pián yi yī biān hǎo chī
items.zh: 这家店的面又便宜又好吃。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn de miàn yòu pián yi yòu hǎo chī
items.en: The noodles at this shop are both cheap and tasty.
items.why: 一边…一边 joins two actions done at the same time. Two qualities need 又…又.

items.src: 这个公园很大，也很漂亮。
items.src_py: zhè ge gōng yuán hěn dà yě hěn piào liang
items.task: Join the two qualities with 又…又.
items.zh: 这个公园又大又漂亮。
items.py: zhè ge gōng yuán yòu dà yòu piào liang
items.en: This park is both big and pretty.
items.why: 又 is placed before each adjective and 很 is dropped.

items.zh: 他一边走路，一边听音乐。
items.py: tā yī biān zǒu lù yī biān tīng yīn yuè
items.en: He listens to music while walking.
items.why: 一边…一边 joins two simultaneous actions. Each 一边 stands right before its verb.

items.q: 他既会打篮球，___会踢足球。
items.zh: 他既会打篮球，又会踢足球。
items.py: tā jì huì dǎ lán qiú yòu huì tī zú qiú
items.en: He can play both basketball and football.
items.why: 既 is answered by 又 (or 也): 既…又. 而且 belongs with 不但, and 所以 states a result.

items.s: 如果你不去，我也不去了。
items.s_py: rú guǒ nǐ bù qù wǒ yě bù qù le
items.zh: 如果你不去，我也不去了。
items.py: rú guǒ nǐ bù qù wǒ yě bù qù le
items.en: If you don't go, I won't go either.
items.why: This is correct. 也 is an adverb after the second subject 我, and 就 is not required in an if-clause.

items.q: 骑自行车不但可以锻炼身体，___可以省钱。
items.zh: 骑自行车不但可以锻炼身体，还可以省钱。
items.py: qí zì xíng chē bù dàn kě yǐ duàn liàn shēn tǐ hái kě yǐ shěng qián
items.en: Cycling not only exercises the body, it also saves money.
items.why: 不但 … 还 adds a second benefit. 就 and 才 would turn the sentence into a condition.

items.q: 这条路又宽___干净。
items.zh: 这条路又宽又干净。
items.py: zhè tiáo lù yòu kuān yòu gān jìng
items.en: This road is both wide and clean.
items.why: 又 must be repeated in front of each quality: 又宽又干净. 也 and 更 do not complete the pair.

items.q: 他一边走路，___看手机，差点儿撞到人。
items.zh: 他一边走路，一边看手机，差点儿撞到人。
items.py: tā yī biān zǒu lù yī biān kàn shǒu jī chà diǎn r zhuàng dào rén
items.en: He was looking at his phone while walking and almost bumped into someone.
items.why: Two actions happening at the same time are joined by 一边…一边. 又 or 再 cannot make the second action simultaneous.

items.s: 一他到球场，就开始热身。
items.s_py: yī tā dào qiú chǎng jiù kāi shǐ rè shēn
items.zh: 他一到球场，就开始热身。
items.py: tā yī dào qiú chǎng jiù kāi shǐ rè shēn
items.en: As soon as he gets to the court, he starts warming up.
items.why: 一 must stand directly before the verb 到, so 他 cannot come between 一 and 到. Say 他一到球场 (or 一到球场，他就…).

items.q: ___参加比赛，他每天早上都练习打篮球。
items.zh: 为了参加比赛，他每天早上都练习打篮球。
items.py: wèi le cān jiā bǐ sài tā měi tiān zǎo shang dōu liàn xí dǎ lán qiú
items.en: In order to take part in the match, he practises basketball every morning.
items.why: Taking part in the match is the goal he works toward, so 为了 is needed. 因为 states a cause that has already happened.

items.s: 只有穿上跑鞋，他就愿意出门。
items.s_py: zhǐ yǒu chuān shàng pǎo xié tā jiù yuàn yì chū mén
items.zh: 只有穿上跑鞋，他才愿意出门。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu chuān shàng pǎo xié tā cái yuàn yì chū mén
items.en: Only if he puts on his running shoes is he willing to go out.
items.why: 只有 is answered by 才. 就 is the partner of 只要 and 如果.

items.q: 如果这家店的球鞋太贵，我___去别的店看看。
items.zh: 如果这家店的球鞋太贵，我就去别的店看看。
items.py: rú guǒ zhè jiā diàn de qiú xié tài guì wǒ jiù qù bié de diàn kàn kan
items.en: If the shoes in this shop are too expensive, I'll look in other shops.
items.why: 如果 pairs with 就 after the second subject 我. 才 would mean 'only then' and 都 needs 不管.

items.q: 他一下班___去健身房，从来不回家吃饭。
items.zh: 他一下班就去健身房，从来不回家吃饭。
items.py: tā yī xià bān jiù qù jiàn shēn fáng cóng lái bù huí jiā chī fàn
items.en: As soon as he finishes work he goes to the gym; he never goes home for dinner.
items.why: 一…就 links two actions that follow at once. 才 would say he goes late, and 再 needs 先 before it.

items.q: 由于下大雨，___足球比赛改到了下周。
items.zh: 由于下大雨，因此足球比赛改到了下周。
items.py: yóu yú xià dà yǔ yīn cǐ zú qiú bǐ sài gǎi dào le xià zhōu
items.en: Owing to the heavy rain, the football match was moved to next week.
items.why: 由于 is answered by 因此 in front of the result clause. 因为 cannot follow 由于, and 虽然 is contrastive.

items.s: 如果下雨，就我们不去了。
items.s_py: rú guǒ xià yǔ jiù wǒ men bù qù le
items.zh: 如果下雨，我们就不去了。
items.py: rú guǒ xià yǔ wǒ men jiù bù qù le
items.en: If it rains, we won't go.
items.why: 就 is an adverb and must follow the second subject 我们, not come before it.

items.s: 不管比赛很难，我们都不放弃。
items.s_py: bù guǎn bǐ sài hěn nán wǒ men dōu bù fàng qì
items.zh: 不管比赛难不难，我们都不放弃。
items.py: bù guǎn bǐ sài nán bu nán wǒ men dōu bù fàng qì
items.en: Whether the match is hard or not, we won't give up.
items.why: 不管 needs an open question such as 难不难. A plain statement like 很难 cannot follow it.

items.q: ___你明天不想去，我们也得去体育馆报名。
items.zh: 就算你明天不想去，我们也得去体育馆报名。
items.py: jiù suàn nǐ míng tiān bù xiǎng qù wǒ men yě děi qù tǐ yù guǎn bào míng
items.en: Even if you don't want to go tomorrow, we still have to go and sign up at the gym.
items.why: The first clause is a supposed case about tomorrow, so 就算 (even if) with 也. 虽然 states something already true.

items.q: 既然地铁站人这么多，我们___走路去吧。
items.zh: 既然地铁站人这么多，我们就走路去吧。
items.py: jì rán dì tiě zhàn rén zhè me duō wǒ men jiù zǒu lù qù ba
items.en: Since there are so many people at the subway station, let's walk.
items.why: 既然 gives a known situation and 就 leads into the suggestion. 才 would mean 'only then'.

items.q: 你应该先拉伸一下，___开始跑步，不然容易受伤。
items.zh: 你应该先拉伸一下，再开始跑步，不然容易受伤。
items.py: nǐ yīng gāi xiān lā shēn yī xià zài kāi shǐ pǎo bù bù rán róng yì shòu shāng
items.en: You should stretch first and then start running, or you'll easily get hurt.
items.why: 先…再 orders two steps in advice. 又 means 'again' and 也 means 'also'; neither marks the next step.

items.s: 除了游泳，他也喜欢爬山。
items.s_py: chú le yóu yǒng tā yě xǐ huan pá shān
items.zh: 除了游泳，他也喜欢爬山。
items.py: chú le yóu yǒng tā yě xǐ huan pá shān
items.en: Besides swimming, he also likes hiking.
items.why: This is correct: 除了 with 也 means 'besides', adding a second thing.

items.q: 这个城市的地铁___来越方便了。
items.zh: 这个城市的地铁越来越方便了。
items.py: zhè ge chéng shì de dì tiě yuè lái yuè fāng biàn le
items.en: The subway in this city is getting more and more convenient.
items.why: The set phrase is 越来越, 'more and more'. 更 and 很 cannot replace 越 inside it.

items.q: 你先热身，___跑步。
items.zh: 你先热身，再跑步。
items.py: nǐ xiān rè shēn zài pǎo bù
items.en: Warm up first, then run.
items.why: 先 marks the first step and 再 the next step in an instruction. 又 is for something that already happened again; 也 means 'also'.

items.q: 无论你坐地铁___坐公交车，都能到市中心。
items.zh: 无论你坐地铁还是坐公交车，都能到市中心。
items.py: wú lùn nǐ zuò dì tiě hái shi zuò gōng jiāo chē dōu néng dào shì zhōng xīn
items.en: Whether you take the subway or the bus, you can get to the city centre.
items.why: After 无论 a choice question needs 还是 (A 还是 B). 和 only joins nouns and 而且 adds information, so neither makes the question.

items.zh: 要是明天天气好的话，我们就骑自行车去公园。
items.py: yào shi míng tiān tiān qì hǎo de huà wǒ men jiù qí zì xíng chē qù gōng yuán
items.en: If the weather is good tomorrow, we'll cycle to the park.
items.why: 就 follows the second subject 我们 and stands before the verb phrase.

items.q: 即使明天有比赛，他___要去看电影。
items.zh: 即使明天有比赛，他也要去看电影。
items.py: jí shǐ míng tiān yǒu bǐ sài tā yě yào qù kàn diàn yǐng
items.en: Even if there is a match tomorrow, he still wants to see a film.
items.why: 即使 supposes a case and takes 也 after the second subject. 但是 and 所以 do not pair with it.

items.q: 不管明天下不下雨，我们___去爬山。
items.zh: 不管明天下不下雨，我们都去爬山。
items.py: bù guǎn míng tiān xià bu xià yǔ wǒ men dōu qù pá shān
items.en: Whether or not it rains tomorrow, we're going hiking.
items.why: 不管 plus a verb-not-verb question needs 都 after the second subject. 才 and 而且 cannot answer it.

items.q: 雨___下越大，比赛只好取消了。
items.zh: 雨越下越大，比赛只好取消了。
items.py: yǔ yuè xià yuè dà bǐ sài zhǐ hǎo qǔ xiāo le
items.en: The rain got heavier and heavier, so the match had to be cancelled.
items.why: 越下越大 is the 越 A 越 B pattern: the more it rains, the heavier. 更 and 又 cannot start it.

items.q: ___多晚回家，他都要先去公园走一圈。
items.zh: 不管多晚回家，他都要先去公园走一圈。
items.py: bù guǎn duō wǎn huí jiā tā dōu yào xiān qù gōng yuán zǒu yī quān
items.en: However late he gets home, he always takes a walk around the park first.
items.why: 多晚 is an open question and 都 is the partner, so the opener is 不管. 只要 would need 就 and 因为 would need 所以.

items.zh: 他的球越踢越好。
items.py: tā de qiú yuè tī yuè hǎo
items.en: His football gets better the more he plays.
items.why: 越 A 越 B puts 越 before the verb and again before the adjective. The two halves cannot be reversed.

items.zh: 如果你去踢球，我也去。
items.py: rú guǒ nǐ qù tī qiú wǒ yě qù
items.en: If you go and play football, I'll go too.
items.why: 也 is an adverb and stays after the second subject 我, right before 去. It cannot open the clause.

items.q: 这个周末，要么你来体育馆找我，___我去你家。
items.zh: 这个周末，要么你来体育馆找我，要么我去你家。
items.py: zhè ge zhōu mò yào me nǐ lái tǐ yù guǎn zhǎo wǒ yào me wǒ qù nǐ jiā
items.en: This weekend, either you come and find me at the gym or I'll come to your place.
items.why: Two options to choose between use 要么…要么. 而是 and 就是 belong with 不是.

items.q: 不但哥哥喜欢爬山，姐姐___喜欢。
items.zh: 不但哥哥喜欢爬山，姐姐也喜欢。
items.py: bù dàn gē ge xǐ huan pá shān jiě jie yě xǐ huan
items.en: Not only my brother likes hiking; my sister likes it too.
items.why: When the two clauses have different subjects, 不但 opens the first and 也 follows the second subject 姐姐. 就 and 才 are not partners of 不但.

items.q: 不管比赛结果___，我们都会为你加油。
items.zh: 不管比赛结果怎么样，我们都会为你加油。
items.py: bù guǎn bǐ sài jié guǒ zěn me yàng wǒ men dōu huì wèi nǐ jiā yóu
items.en: Whatever the result of the match, we'll cheer for you.
items.why: 不管 must be followed by a question form such as 怎么样. A plain statement like 很好 or 不好 cannot follow it.

items.s: 虽然天气不好，我们还是去公园了。
items.s_py: suī rán tiān qì bù hǎo wǒ men hái shi qù gōng yuán le
items.zh: 虽然天气不好，我们还是去公园了。
items.py: suī rán tiān qì bù hǎo wǒ men hái shi qù gōng yuán le
items.en: Although the weather was bad, we still went to the park.
items.why: This is correct. 还是 'still' can carry the contrast, so 但是 is not always needed.

items.zh: 因为地铁坏了，所以我们走路去体育馆。
items.py: yīn wèi dì tiě huài le suǒ yǐ wǒ men zǒu lù qù tǐ yù guǎn
items.en: Because the subway was out of service, we walked to the gym.
items.why: 所以 is a conjunction and comes before the second subject (or the subject is moved in front of 因为).

items.s: 即使天很冷，所以他们也去爬山。
items.s_py: jí shǐ tiān hěn lěng suǒ yǐ tā men yě qù pá shān
items.zh: 即使天很冷，他们也去爬山。
items.py: jí shǐ tiān hěn lěng tā men yě qù pá shān
items.en: Even if it's very cold, they'll still go hiking.
items.why: 即使 supposes a case and is answered by 也 alone. 所以 presents a result of a real cause and cannot follow 即使.

items.s: 他不是在打球，但是在看球。
items.s_py: tā bù shì zài dǎ qiú dàn shì zài kàn qiú
items.zh: 他不是在打球，而是在看球。
items.py: tā bù shì zài dǎ qiú ér shì zài kàn qiú
items.en: He isn't playing; he's watching a game.
items.why: 不是 is completed by 而是 for a correction. 但是 cannot replace it.

items.q: 要是明天不下雨，我们___去踢足球。
items.zh: 要是明天不下雨，我们就去踢足球。
items.py: yào shi míng tiān bù xià yǔ wǒ men jiù qù tī zú qiú
items.en: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we'll go and play football.
items.why: 要是 (if) takes 就 after the second subject 我们. 才 would mean 'only then', which turns a simple if into a strict requirement.

items.q: 他们不是坐地铁去，___骑自行车去。
items.zh: 他们不是坐地铁去，而是骑自行车去。
items.py: tā men bù shì zuò dì tiě qù ér shì qí zì xíng chē qù
items.en: They aren't going by subway; they are going by bike.
items.why: The cue denies one way and states the true one: 不是 A 而是 B. 就是 would make it 'either subway or bike'.

items.zh: 即使今天输了比赛，我们也不会放弃。
items.py: jí shǐ jīn tiān shū le bǐ sài wǒ men yě bù huì fàng qì
items.en: Even if we lose the match today, we won't give up.
items.why: 也 is an adverb after the second subject 我们 and before 不会放弃.

items.s: 只要不下雨，比赛就照常进行。
items.s_py: zhǐ yào bù xià yǔ bǐ sài jiù zhào cháng jìn xíng
items.zh: 只要不下雨，比赛就照常进行。
items.py: zhǐ yào bù xià yǔ bǐ sài jiù zhào cháng jìn xíng
items.en: As long as it doesn't rain, the match goes ahead as normal.
items.why: This is correct: 只要 takes 就, placed after the second subject 比赛.

items.q: 周末他不是在球场打球，___在家看比赛。
items.zh: 周末他不是在球场打球，就是在家看比赛。
items.py: zhōu mò tā bù shì zài qiú chǎng dǎ qiú jiù shì zài jiā kàn bǐ sài
items.en: At weekends he is either playing ball on the court or watching a match at home.
items.why: The cue says it is always one of the two: 不是 A 就是 B. 而是 would correct a mistaken idea, and 要么 cannot follow 不是.

items.zh: 不管下不下雨，我们都去爬山。
items.py: bù guǎn xià bu xià yǔ wǒ men dōu qù pá shān
items.en: Whether it rains or not, we're going hiking.
items.why: 都 is an adverb: it follows the second-clause subject 我们 and comes before 去爬山.

items.s: 他既会骑自行车，又会开车，所以上班很方便。
items.s_py: tā jì huì qí zì xíng chē yòu huì kāi chē suǒ yǐ shàng bān hěn fāng biàn
items.zh: 他既会骑自行车，又会开车，所以上班很方便。
items.py: tā jì huì qí zì xíng chē yòu huì kāi chē suǒ yǐ shàng bān hěn fāng biàn
items.en: He can both ride a bike and drive, so getting to work is easy.
items.why: This is correct: 既…又 joins two abilities, and 所以 starts the result clause.

items.q: 除了踢足球，他___喜欢打乒乓球。
items.zh: 除了踢足球，他也喜欢打乒乓球。
items.py: chú le tī zú qiú tā yě xǐ huan dǎ pīng pāng qiú
items.en: Besides playing football, he also likes table tennis.
items.why: 'Besides' adds a second item, so 也 (or 还). 都 means 'all except', and there is only one object here.

items.q: 你先往前走，___往右转，就到了。
items.zh: 你先往前走，再往右转，就到了。
items.py: nǐ xiān wǎng qián zǒu zài wǎng yòu zhuǎn jiù dào le
items.en: Go straight first, then turn right, and you're there.
items.why: 先 starts the directions and 再 gives the next step. 才 would mean 'only then' and does not follow 先 here.

items.zh: 路上的车越来越多了。
items.py: lù shang de chē yuè lái yuè duō le
items.en: There are more and more cars on the road.
items.why: 越来越 comes directly before the adjective 多 with no 很, and 了 closes the sentence.

items.q: 尽管比赛已经结束了，观众们___不想离开体育馆。
items.zh: 尽管比赛已经结束了，观众们还是不想离开体育馆。
items.py: jǐn guǎn bǐ sài yǐ jīng jié shù le guān zhòng men hái shi bù xiǎng lí kāi tǐ yù guǎn
items.en: Even though the match was over, the spectators still didn't want to leave the stadium.
items.why: 尽管 states a fact and the outcome goes against it: 还是 'still'. 所以 and 因此 present a result and cannot follow 尽管.

items.q: ___买到便宜的票，他一大早就去排队了。
items.zh: 为了买到便宜的票，他一大早就去排队了。
items.py: wèi le mǎi dào pián yi de piào tā yī dà zǎo jiù qù pái duì le
items.en: In order to get cheap tickets, he went to queue first thing in the morning.
items.why: Getting cheap tickets is the goal of queueing, so 为了. 因为 would give a cause that already exists, and 既然 needs a fact to build on.

items.src: 他想进校队，所以每天早上练球。
items.src_py: tā xiǎng jìn xiào duì suǒ yǐ měi tiān zǎo shang liàn qiú
items.zh: 为了进校队，他每天早上练球。
items.py: wèi le jìn xiào duì tā měi tiān zǎo shang liàn qiú
items.en: In order to get into the school team, he practises every morning.
items.why: The goal becomes a 为了 phrase and 所以 is dropped, because 为了 and 所以 do not go together.

items.q: 只要不下雨，我们___去公园。
items.zh: 只要不下雨，我们就去公园。
items.py: zhǐ yào bù xià yǔ wǒ men jiù qù gōng yuán
items.en: As long as it doesn't rain, we'll go to the park.
items.why: 只要 means one easy condition is enough and takes 就. 才 goes with 只有.

items.q: 只有对这座城市非常熟悉的人，___能不用地图找到那条小路。
items.zh: 只有对这座城市非常熟悉的人，才能不用地图找到那条小路。
items.py: zhǐ yǒu duì zhè zuò chéng shì fēi cháng shú xī de rén cái néng bù yòng dì tú zhǎo dào nà tiáo xiǎo lù
items.en: Only someone who knows this city very well can find that little lane without a map.
items.why: 只有 limits the condition to a special group and takes 才. 就 would mean anyone at all could do it.

items.s: 雨越下越大，我们只好回家了。
items.s_py: yǔ yuè xià yuè dà wǒ men zhǐ hǎo huí jiā le
items.zh: 雨越下越大，我们只好回家了。
items.py: yǔ yuè xià yuè dà wǒ men zhǐ hǎo huí jiā le
items.en: The rain got heavier and heavier, so we had to go home.
items.why: This is correct: 越 + verb + 越 + adjective, with no 很 and no 越来越.

items.q: 我不是不想参加比赛，___最近工作太忙，没有时间练习。
items.zh: 我不是不想参加比赛，而是最近工作太忙，没有时间练习。
items.py: wǒ bù shì bù xiǎng cān jiā bǐ sài ér shì zuì jìn gōng zuò tài máng méi yǒu shí jiān liàn xí
items.en: It's not that I don't want to take part in the match; I've just been too busy at work to practise.
items.why: 不是…而是 corrects the supposed reason. 而且 would add information and 所以 would turn the real reason into a result.

items.q: 既然你想学游泳，我们___去报名吧。
items.zh: 既然你想学游泳，我们就去报名吧。
items.py: jì rán nǐ xiǎng xué yóu yǒng wǒ men jiù qù bào míng ba
items.en: Since you want to learn swimming, let's go and sign up.
items.why: 既然 introduces a known fact and takes 就 for the suggestion. 所以 and 因为 do not pair with 既然.

items.q: 除了星期天，我每天___去游泳。
items.zh: 除了星期天，我每天都去游泳。
items.py: chú le xīng qī tiān wǒ měi tiān dōu qù yóu yǒng
items.en: I go swimming every day except Sunday.
items.why: Sunday is left out, so the partner is 都. 还 would mean 'in addition to Sunday', which makes no sense with 每天.

items.q: 她不但会游泳，___会打网球。
items.zh: 她不但会游泳，而且会打网球。
items.py: tā bù dàn huì yóu yǒng ér qiě huì dǎ wǎng qiú
items.en: She can not only swim, she can also play tennis.
items.why: 不但 is completed by 而且 (or 还), adding a second ability. 但是 and 所以 break the 'not only' structure.

items.s: 既然你累了，我们才回家吧。
items.s_py: jì rán nǐ lèi le wǒ men cái huí jiā ba
items.zh: 既然你累了，我们就回家吧。
items.py: jì rán nǐ lèi le wǒ men jiù huí jiā ba
items.en: Since you're tired, let's go home.
items.why: 既然 leads to a suggestion with 就. 才 means 'only then' and clashes with a suggestion.

items.s: 只要穿上这双鞋，你才能跑得快。
items.s_py: zhǐ yào chuān shàng zhè shuāng xié nǐ cái néng pǎo de kuài
items.zh: 只要穿上这双鞋，你就能跑得快。
items.py: zhǐ yào chuān shàng zhè shuāng xié nǐ jiù néng pǎo de kuài
items.en: As long as you wear these shoes, you can run fast.
items.why: 只要 is answered by 就. 才 belongs with 只有.

items.q: 不管刮风下雨，他每天___去公园打太极拳。
items.zh: 不管刮风下雨，他每天都去公园打太极拳。
items.py: bù guǎn guā fēng xià yǔ tā měi tiān dōu qù gōng yuán dǎ tài jí quán
items.en: Rain or shine, he goes to the park every day to do tai chi.
items.why: 不管 is answered by 都 after the subject. 才 would mean 'only then' and 但是 is a conjunction for 虽然.

items.q: 这个游泳池又大___深。
items.zh: 这个游泳池又大又深。
items.py: zhè ge yóu yǒng chí yòu dà yòu shēn
items.en: This swimming pool is both big and deep.
items.why: 又 is repeated before each adjective: 又大又深. 也 or 更 cannot be the second half.

items.q: 城市___大，交通问题___严重。
items.zh: 城市越大，交通问题越严重。
items.py: chéng shì yuè dà jiāo tōng wèn tí yuè yán zhòng
items.en: The bigger a city is, the more serious its traffic problems.
items.why: 'The more A, the more B' is 越 A 越 B. 又…又 would list two qualities and 很 cannot form a pair.

items.q: 妹妹游得越来越___了。
items.zh: 妹妹游得越来越好了。
items.py: mèi mei yóu de yuè lái yuè hǎo le
items.en: My younger sister swims better and better.
items.why: 越来越 already carries the degree, so the adjective stands bare. 很 and 非常 cannot follow it.
